title: Captain
description: The original is an impressive sports manga featuring not heroes, but common boys, and the story depicts the growth of Sumiya 2 junior high school baseball team (the successive captains and players) in downtown Tokyo. Takao Taniguchi, who was a substitute player of the second team of Aoba Gakuin, a prestigious junior high school in the baseball world, but he transferred to Sumiya 2 and he became the captain of the baseball club. After steady training, the team try to do a final game in the regional preliminaries, against Aoba Gakuin.

title: Endro!
description:
Naral Island, a continent with swords and magic in which humans and monsters coexist. The terrible Demon King lives there. In ancient times, the first-generation hero defeated the Demon King. Over the many successive generations since then, the Demon King has been resurrected, and the hero who opposes him has likewise reappeared. Girls attend a school for adventurers in order to defeat the Demon King when he appears again.

Though a bit absent-minded, Yusha has the body of a hero. The holy elf Seyla's trouble never ends because she is too serious. The cheerful warrior Fai loves to eat. Mei is a quiet otaku magician. As the four girls aim to be in the hero party, they live relaxed fantasy lives and show no sign of defeating the Demon King no matter how much time passes.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - It's Still Too Soon for the End Roll!
episodes.description: Yulia Chardiet--the girl known as Yusha, was once a young girl unshaped by the world. Yet through the friends she met and the friendship they shared, she gained a dream of becoming the Hero. This was her first step on the journey of a plain girl realizing her vibrant dream alongside her friends--yes, the tale of a Hero. (Source: The Legend of the Hero, Yusha, Prologue: A Plain Girl)

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Demon Lord, Vanish into the Sunset!
episodes.description: Chosen by the Hero's Sword, Yusha finally becomes the Hero she longed to be. However, being the Hero doesn't necessarily make her the leader of the party. There are many different things that makes someone qualified to be a leader-organization, judgment, charisma, or even appearance. In short, Yusha was not the only one possessing such qualities. Seira, Fai, and Mei possessed them as well. Now, which do you believe was fitting to be their leader? (Excerpt from "Study of Leadership Seen in the Hero's Party")

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Quest Practical!
episodes.description: dventurers take on work known as quests, and receive rewards for their resolution. The Hero's Party too were adventurers, and it is said they took on many challenging quests. There are various theories, but the first quest Yusha and her comrades accepted is said to be a quest to find something very important. What kind of quest was worthy of the Hero's Party? A very intriguing question. (Excerpt from "First Quest! -Are You Forgetting Anything?-")

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Ocean, Swimsuits, and Slaying Evil Gods!
episodes.description: The Hero's Party continued to produce results as they learned at the Adventurer's School. However, one thing must not be forgotten. While they were the heroines of the Hero Party, they were also still typical young girls. Young girls who hoped to enjoy a peaceful vacation on a quiet beach. Still, even then, they could not escape their destiny. And so, it came from the sea... (Excerpt from "It Came From the Sea - Strange Tales of the Hero -")

episodes.title: Ep 5 - My Hero!
episodes.description: Throughout history, many Heroes have received support from the Kingdom on their journeys. This is because the Hero serves as a means of resisting the Demon Lord's forces, but also because the Hero then acts as a powerful advertisement of the Royal Family's authority to their people. Thus, the Hero and the Royal Family become inseparable, and so the Princess of Naral Island's Royal Family appeared before Yusha's party as well. Now, what was it that she hoped to achieved with her visit? (Excerpt from "A Statesman's Guide to the Merits and Demerits of Supporting the Hero")

episodes.title: Ep 6 - One Room, 100 Square Feet, Demon Lord Included!
episodes.description: The Hero's teacher was the renowned Mao. She never once gave Yusha and the others special treatment and provided them with the same strict education as the rest of her students, if not stricter. While Mao took it upon herself to act the villain, hoping that she might raise them into a splendid Hero's Party, one day she learned how her students truly felt. Yes, it was on the day she fell ill that-- (Excerpt taken from "I Raised the Hero -How to Raise a Hero as Told by Their Teacher-")

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Princess Rona, Fait On!
episodes.description: Lapanesta Kingdom's Princess Rona was a major supporter of the Hero's Party. Yet while she spent time furthering her acquaintance with not only Yusha, but Seira and Mei as well, she had quite some difficulty with Fai. Perhaps the Princess and a wild child from the woods simply came from worlds that were too different? Yet one day, those two found an opportunity to go on a journey together. Princess Rona hoped to use that chance to deepen their bonds, however... (Excerpt from "The Princess of the Royal Palace and the Wilds")

episodes.title: Ep 8 - My Yusha-sama!
episodes.description: Since ancient times the Demon Lord has kidnapped a princess to lay in wait for the Hero at Demon Lord Castle. However, records show that these princesses responded to their kidnappings in many different ways, with some falling in love with the Demon Lord as they spent time with them, some hitting it off with the Demon Lord and joining them in their quest for world conquest, and some who tried to defeat the Demon Lord before the Hero arrived. So -- what fate awaited Princess Rona when she was kidnapped by the Demon Lord after its sudden appearance? (Excerpt from "Demon Lords Love Princesses?")

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Secret Cartado Festival!
episodes.description: Naral Island is a mysterious island that's hard to call either small or large, and there are many unexplored regions sleeping within. Yet the Hero's sworn friend and famous supreme Cartado Master, Mather Enderstto, was another who was intrigued by such unexplored regions. However, she ultimately managed to discover one. Yes, the forbidden land where the secrets of Cartado lie... That was the beginning of her adventure into the taboo. (Excerpt from "Top 1000 Unexplored Regions of Naral Island")

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Snowy Mountain Dream!
episodes.description: A Hero's Party always needs someone to maintain harmony amongst the group in addition to their leader. For example, in Yusha's party, Seira - or Ellenoar Seiran - served in this role. With her diligence and common sense, Seira was a key pillar of their otherwise freewheeling party. This particular tale is one of the priest Seira's lonely battle as she stood boldly against a threat that could have ruined their party... (Excerpt from "Heroes and Their True Companions -- In 999 Generations, There Are Sure to be Parties That Don't Get Along")

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Final Dead End!
episodes.description: After defeating the Demon Lord, one Hero left this statement on record: "If the Demon Lord were pure evil, then we wouldn't agonize this much over what we've done." The Hero and the Demon Lord, two who are destined to fight. However, if there were some justice to the Demon Lord's actions, then would the Heroes still be able to brandish their swords? And what on earth is the Final Dead End that holds the key to everything? (Excerpt from "Heroes and Demon Lords -True Records That Were Never Passed Down-")

episodes.title: Ep 12 - After the End Roll...
episodes.description: The resurrected Demon Lord finally appeared before Yusha, Seira, Fai, and Mei, so the four set out for Demon Lord Castle to save their kidnapped friend. However, during their travels, the young girls learned the truth about the Demon Lord. Demon Lord or friend? The four girls set forth, still deliberating over that unanswered question, together with the precious companions they knew they could trust no matter. And as the curtain drew on their final battle -- (Excerpt from "Legend of the Hero, Yusha - Final Chapter: I Love Everyone!-")

title: Gintama 2: The Exceedingly Strange Gintama-chan
description: The adventures of the Yorozuya gang and their friends.

title: Dr. STONE
description: Awakened into a world where humanity has been petrified, scientific genius Senku and his brawny friend Taiju use their skills to rebuild civilization.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - RYUSUI VS. SENKU
episodes.description: Senku and his companions finally set off for America in search of corn. However, a dispute arises between Ryusui and Senku shortly after they depart.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - SCIENCE JOURNEY
episodes.description: Maintaining morale will be critical on the long journey to the Americas. Knowing where on the ocean you are is pretty important, too. The crew of the Perseus discuss.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Light Trap in the Darkness
episodes.description: The Perseus lands in the Americas. They first head to Northern California in search of yellow dent corn, but discover a lot more than that.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Dr. X
episodes.description: The search party narrowly escaped enemy machine gun fire. Unfortunately, the respite was short-lived.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - DOCTOR VS. DOCTOR
episodes.description: Tensions rise as Dr. Xeno makes his introductions to the Perseus.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - SCIENCE IS ELEGANT
episodes.description: Stanley orders Luna to infiltrate the Perseus and identify Doctor Taiju. Things go sideways when it turns out to be a little too easy.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - The Two Scientists
episodes.description: Senku had gotten his start in rocket building through an email exchange with Doctor Xeno. Their approaches to science soon diverged.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - LOCK ON
episodes.description: NASA scientist Dr. Xeno attempts to pick off the leader of the Kingdom of Science.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Light of Science
episodes.description: With Senku having been shot, the Kingdom of Science plots its retaliation against Dr. Xeno.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Dirty Roads
episodes.description: With Senku still confined to the bed, Chrome's team begins work on the tunnel to Xeno's base.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Those Who Know the Rules; Those Who Make Them
episodes.description: Ryusui and Senku take to the skies in a science versus science dogfight while Xeno's forces mount a ground counterattack.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Reunion
episodes.description: Xeno's army attacks and when all seems lost, Chrome and his friends finish the tunnel and capture Xeno.

episodes.title: Ep 13 - Watching the Same Moon
episodes.description: The team head to the source of the petrification beam in South America as they flee from Stanley's ship.

episodes.title: Ep 14 - EARTH RACE
episodes.description: Senku and company must flee from Stanley's ship, but they have to make stops to refuel.

episodes.title: Ep 15 - The Escape
episodes.description: Senku and his friends are racing at full speed with Stanley, heading for South America, the source of the petrification ray. They welcome the genius geographer Chelsea into their team and push forward with the shortest route to their destination! First, Senku and his friends want to craft a "bike" in preparation for crossing the Amazon. In order to buy time to get the essential material "rubber," they try a decoy operation against Stanley and his friends...! In order to break through Stanley's encirclement, Senku and his friends try to build a bike at lightning speed!

episodes.title: Ep 16 - Medusa Mechanism
episodes.description: The team is going to need a weapon for when Stanley inevitably catches up to them.

title: Sorairo Utility
description: High schooler Minami, ready to become the protagonist in her own story, runs away from school and finds golf at a driving range.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - Special Encounters
episodes.description: It's game over for one hobby and game on for a new one. High schooler Minami puts down a video game and picks up golf!

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Special Friend
episodes.description: Haruka provides Minami some guidance. Minami’s first shot ever on a golf course is one to remember.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Special Job
episodes.description: Haruka gives Minami her old golf set. Minami is excited to have the "ultimate equipment" but realizes the driving range costs a lot of money. She gets a part-time job.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Special Club
episodes.description: Minami steps into her very first golf shop. She bursts with excitement at the cute golf covers and golf wear. What really catches her attention is the "utility" golf club.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Special Training
episodes.description: Minami is full of excitement; however, she isn't feeling any rapid progress. Meanwhile, her midterm exams lay ahead.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Special Round
episodes.description: Minami is in for a lot of firsts! She heads towards her very first round at her very first golf course and she hits her first shot with the utility.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Special Finishing Move!
episodes.description: Minami borrows a light novel from her classmate, Izumi. She unintentionally gains a hint on how to level up her golf game.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Special Caddie
episodes.description: Ayaka suggests they use prize money to play golf on a gorgeous course. Meanwhile, there appears to be something going on between Haruka and Megumi.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Special Buzz
episodes.description: Minami realizes she and Haruka have not seen Ayaka for some time now. Ayaka stopped posting on her social media. What's going on?

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Special Milady!?
episodes.description: On a rainy day Minami and Ayaka start practicing simulation golf. However, a small challenge barges into their game.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Special Doubles Match
episodes.description: The foursome is split up into teams consisting of Minami with Hina, and Haruka with Ayaka, to play a round using doubles rules.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Special 'Special'
episodes.description: A divine message, or just a dream? There's only one way to find out, and Minami knows where to look for answers... but is she brave enough to go solo for the first time?

title: I'm Living with an Otaku NEET Kunoichi!?
description: In order to protect an ordinary businessman, Tsukasa Atsumi, from demons, a genius kunoichi, Shizuri Ideura, signs a master-servant contract with him on the condition that she stays with him. Despite her cool appearance of defeating demons, Shizuri is an otaku NEET who spends all her time playing video games. While Shizuri is spoiled by Tsukasa and leads a lazy cohabitation life, the quirky Kunoichi gather together.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - Somehow I Started Living with an Otaku NEET Kunoichi
episodes.description: Kunoichi Shizuri saves average salaryman Tsukasa from a near death experience!

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Somehow a Perverted Kunoichi Showed Up
episodes.description: Tsukasa forgets his lunch which sets of a series of events leading to Ayame’s arrival.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Somehow a Kunoichi with Very Bad Luck Showed Up
episodes.description: After sending Ayame away, a new kunoichi appears.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Somehow I Was Targeted by a CPL Kunoichi
episodes.description: Tsukasa goes out on his own and is ambushed.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - For Some Reason, Kunoichi Lovers Moved In
episodes.description: Tsukasa discovers something about Ayame during a fight with a Yoma.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Somehow a Rom-Com Loving High School Girl Was Monitoring Me
episodes.description: Shizuri is disappointed by a lack of lovey-dovey feelings.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Somehow I Suffered for a Date
episodes.description: Shizuri is determined to find out Tsukasa's feelings toward her.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Somehow I Fully Enjoyed My Akiba Date
episodes.description: Tsukasa asks Shizuri to accompany him shopping in Akihabara.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Somehow the High School Girl Reached a New Love Frontier
episodes.description: When Tsukasa and Shizuri went on their Akiba date, Himari staked out in the bushes to snoop.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Somehow a Tsundere Kunoichi Showed Up
episodes.description: Hina drives back a Yoma that has ambushed her master, Toru.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Somehow a Kunoichi Maid Burst Onto the Scene
episodes.description: Hina's extremely bad luck is out of control.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Somehow I Decided to Quit Being a NEET
episodes.description: The kunoichi succeeds in paying off the debt owed to Saya.

episodes.title: Ep 13 - Somehow the Former NEET Did Her Best with Chores and Work
episodes.description: Shizuri decides to stop being a NEET. How hard could that be?

title: Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You.
description: It’s the year 2020, and Mizuho is having the worst 17th birthday ever. Her parents forgot it’s her birthday, she still can’t seem to get close to the senior she likes, and all her school trips and tournaments are canceled thanks to a new disease going around. She’s convinced she’ll never have the kind of youth she’s always dreamt of…until her childhood friend, Kizuki, suddenly asks her out.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - An Awful Birthday
episodes.description: July 1st, 2030. Manga editor Nishino Mizuho is having the worst 27th birthday ever. The manga she’s in charge of will be ending. However, when she sees a group of high school students having fun, she recalls her own adolescence. 10 years ago, during her second year of high school, Mizuho had four childhood friends who she grew up with in a residential neighborhood known as Koigahama Highlands…

episodes.title: Ep 2 - I'll Be by Your Side
episodes.description: Kizuki, who Mizuho saw as the crybaby little brother of the group, has lately been hitting on her. Since Mizuho believed her and Kizuki would be childhood friends forever, she is not sure how to approach this situation. He's on her mind to the point where she seems disoriented, and even says something that could potentially push Kizuki away.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Warmth
episodes.description: Afraid of ruining their relationship, Mizuho tells herself not to fall for Kizuki. All the stress makes her ill, and her friends come to help.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Fireworks for the Future
episodes.description: After spending the day at the aquarium, Kizuki asks Mizuho to cheer for him at his swim meet.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - How to Be Together Forever
episodes.description: As the fireworks are set off, Mizuho rushes to look for Kizuki. At the pool she runs into...?

episodes.title: Ep 6 - I Don't Want to Be Just Friends
episodes.description: Mizuho is reluctant to visit Kizuki's house for dinner while her dad is away.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Playing Nice
episodes.description: Shugo's older brother, Togo, makes a surprise return to Koigahama Highlands.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - The Shape of One-Sided Love
episodes.description: Mizuho goes out with Shugo and Togo and strongly contemplates her feelings for Kizuki.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - The Times I Spent With You
episodes.description: Shin steps up as the student council president to ensure the Ao High Festival can be held.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Impulse
episodes.description: The group goes on a camping trip! Airu tells Shin to be more selfish and he follows his suggestion.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Things That Change
episodes.description: Mizuho starts becoming aware of Shin's intentions after he kissed her at the campsite.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Neverending Dream
episodes.description: Shin and Kizuki compete over Mizuho. Meanwhile she finds out the results of the Newcomers' Manga Competition.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - Don't Let Anyone Find Out
Ep 12 - I Have a Crush at Work

title: Mashin Creator Wataru
description: Wataru Hoshibe, an elementary school student in fourth grade, is a RyuTuber who wants to become a superstar. His adventure begins in the Chubukai parallel world alongside Ryujinmaru, a Mashin that Wataru created out of blocks to defeat the final boss, Enjoda!

episodes.title: Ep 1 - 【The Savior is a RyuTuber】Wataru Hoshibe has Arrived!
episodes.description: Wataru Hoshibe and his cousin Kakeru Amabe prepare to stream on RyuTube, when they are suddenly pulled into the parallel world of Chubukai.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - 【Survival】Will Kakeru and Friends Pull Through?

title: Farmagia
description: In Felicidad, farmers known as the Farmagia raise monsters under the peaceful rule of the Magus Diluculum. After the Magus passes, a power struggle erupts among forces using monsters to seize control. In the town of Centvelt, Farmagia Ten and his friends band together against the despotic new ruler, Glaza. Ten, his friends, and their home-grown monsters must stay strong to defend their freedom.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - The Beginning of Chaos
episodes.description: On the vast farmlands of Centvelt in the continent of Avrion, the Farmagias diligently tend to their fields. Meanwhile, Ten spends his days slacking off, focused on raising the ultimate monster. One day, shocking news arrives: The Magus Diluculum has suddenly died.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Rebellion of Avrion
episodes.description: Airing on Friday, January 17, 2025 Ten and Leii face off against the masked warrior Zanas, who attacks an orphanage. Overwhelmed by the vast difference in their abilities as Farmagias, the two find themselves in a dire situation. However, with the timely assistance of Nares, they manage to successfully repel Zanas. After the battle, gazing upon the ruins of the burned-down orphanage, Ten and the others resolve to rebel against the new Magus, Glaza.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Reunion in Enemy Territory
episodes.description: To defeat Manas, Ten, Leii, and Arche infiltrate Perfectus as an elite strike team, aiming for the castle. During their mission, they reunite with their missing comrade, Emero. While Ten is overjoyed by the reunion, Emero gazes at them with a stern expression and utters a chilling remark.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Uniting Bonds
episodes.description: Determined to match Emero, who demonstrated mastery over controlling monster powers, Ten repeatedly attempts to "Unite" but fails no matter how hard he tries, growing increasingly frustrated. Then, Emero appears before Ten and the others once more, but this time, he shows even greater hostility toward them.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - To the City of Muscles
episodes.description: After defeating Manas and returning to Avrion, Ten and the others let Arche rest to recover from a sudden collapse. Ten and Leii then head to their next destination, Rahatluk, on their own. Successfully infiltrating the city, they pull a cart through the streets, only to realize someone is hiding in the cargo. That person is...

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Beyond the Corpses
episodes.description: As Ten and the others panic over Chica's disappearance, Zanas once again stands in their way. Effortlessly deflecting their attacks, Zanas reveals that Chica has been captured by the Corpus before leaving. Determined to ensure their dear comrade's safety, Ten and his group rush to Rahatluk Fortress.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - In return for the Truth
episodes.description: After a fierce battle with the Corpus, Ten and his group emerge victorious. Returning to Avrion, they throw a party to celebrate Emero's return. While everyone enjoys the festivities, Ten, worried about Arche’s absence due to poor health, goes to visit her—only to discover that she has disappeared. Together with his comrades, Ten desperately searches for her, but...

episodes.title: Ep 8 - The Chosen Ones
episodes.description: Receiving a report from Anzar, who has infiltrated Sonrisa and uncovered the guard placements, Nares assigns Ten and the group the mission to defeat L'Oreille. They land in Sonrisa and begin their advance, but while Anzar steps away to scout the enemy, they are ambushed by L'Oreille, Zanas, and Glaza.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - The Three Angels
episodes.description: On the day of peace negotiations, Nares faces L'Oreille with her army on the continent of. Tension fills the air as Ten and the others quietly observe the two. Declaring no intent to attack, Nares speaks calmly, but L'Oreille, with a sinister smile, unleashes the supposedly undecipherable grand magic, "Harvest Festival.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Through the Darkness
episodes.description: Nares wakes up in the Magus’s castle, where she is shocked to see the Oración Seis, who were believed to be dead. To her further confusion, Lisan mocks her, and standing before her is the former Magus, Diluculum. Meanwhile, Ten and the others, assaulted by L'Oreille, are swallowed by an impenetrable darkness with no light in sight.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - The Path of the Brother
episodes.description: Having completely lost their sense of self, the Oración Seis transform into Reapers and charge at Ten and the others with terrifying roars. Each of them faces a one-on-one battle, but Ten, confronted by Nares, hesitates to fight. Unable to summon any monsters, he desperately continues to call out to her, torn and unsure of what to do.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Dragons of Centvelt
episodes.description: Together with Anzar, who has regained his sense of self, Ten and the others challenge the Magus Diluculum to a final battle. However, even their strongest attacks have no effect on Diluculum. As the world gradually collapses due to the "Grand Harvest Festival," Ten and his comrades continue to struggle desperately, refusing to give up.

title: Solo Leveling
description: They say whatever doesn’t kill you makes you stronger, but that’s not the case for the world’s weakest hunter Sung Jinwoo. After being brutally slaughtered by monsters in a high-ranking dungeon, Jinwoo came back with the System, a program only he could see, that’s leveling him up in every way. Now, he’s inspired to discover the secrets behind his powers and the dungeon that spawned them.
tagline: He used to be the weakest.

title: Himouto! Umaru-chan
description:
People are not always who they appear to be, as is the case with Umaru Doma, the perfect high school girl—that is, until she gets home! Once the front door closes, the real fun begins. When she dons her hamster hoodie, she transforms from a refined, over-achieving student into a lazy, junk food-eating otaku, leaving all the housework to her responsible older brother Taihei. Whether she's hanging out with her friends Nana Ebina and Kirie Motoba, or competing with her self-proclaimed "rival" Sylphinford Tachibana, Umaru knows how to kick back and have some fun!

Himouto! Umaru-chan is a cute story that follows the daily adventures of Umaru and Taihei, as they take care of—and put up with—each other the best they can, as well as the unbreakable bonds between friends and siblings.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - Umaru and Her Brother
episodes.description: Responsible Taihei has to deal with his lazy little sister, Umaru, who trashes his apartment and throws tantrums to get manga and junk food.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Umaru and Ebina
episodes.description: Taihei comes home to a complete stranger: Umaru’s public face. She’s cleaned the apartment and hidden her games to be able to invite her classmate and neighbor, Ebina, over.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Umaru and Her Disciple
episodes.description: Umaru’s sulky, glaring classmate, Motoba, has unexpectedly shown up at her door… while she’s wearing her hood! Is her secret out?

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Umaru and Her Rival
episodes.description: Umaru, aka UMR, is a force to be reckoned with in the arcade. She’s invited to participate in a fighting game championship only to bump into her school rival, Tachibana.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Umaru and Summer Vacation
episodes.description: Summer vacation means hours at the arcade! Umaru instructs in the fine art of enjoying summer like a (lazy) pro. Later, Taihei endures another typical day at work.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Umaru’s Birthday
episodes.description: Taihei and Umaru experiment with free time and personal space in their little apartment, and playing “The Game of Life” hits too close to home for them all.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Umaru’s Big Brother
episodes.description: People in his office have seen Taihei walking home and going shopping with a hot girl! His coworker comes over for a visit to see this so-called “sister” for himself.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Umaru and Christmas and New Year's
episodes.description: In the Doma household, winter means lazy days beneath the kotatsu! Umaru reflects on her interesting year while Taihei tries to collect on a promise she made to him.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Umaru and Valentine’s
episodes.description: It’s Valentine’s Day! Kirie burns cookies, Ebina attempts to make chocolate, and Umaru continues to offload food prep to Taihei.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Umaru and Now and Once Upon a Time
episodes.description: Umaru gets sick, but it’s a good thing her germs are as lazy as she is! Sadly, her germs show her brother no mercy. Later, Taihei remembers a day at the arcade, 10 years ago.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Umaru's Everyday Life
episodes.description: Umaru and Ebina discover that their appetites match, the council in Umaru’s head furiously debates about the perfect snack, and Taihei tries to get Kirie excited for summer.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Umaru and Everyone
episodes.description: In this last episode of the season, Umaru might have to reveal her secret when her separate circles of friends come together during a much anticipated trip to the beach!

title: Tadaima, Okaeri
description: Masaki struggles with self-worth as an omega parent, but just as life feels stable, the past comes knocking with uneasy motives.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - It's Nice to Meet You
episodes.description: A visit to Hiromu's office leads to an awkward situation for shy househusband Masaki, but baby Hikari continues to be a soothing presence in their lives. At Christmastime, Hikari becomes fascinated with the star at the top of the tree.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Friend
episodes.description: Hikari latches onto the reluctant and gloomy neighbor boy, Yuki. Later, when Masaki falls ill and needs to isolate himself, Hiromu and company try their best to distract Hikari from "Ma-cha's" absence.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Sorry
episodes.description: Hiromu's disapproving father Koji shows up at the house unannounced, when Hikari the hero swoops in to protect his parents! But when it becomes apparent that Koji's visits have another agenda, can Hikari the hero save his family again?

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Shining Days
episodes.description: As the family prepares for their second child, Hikari gets excited for his new role as big brother, but Masaki is overcome with worry over his new child's future. Later, the family plays hide and seek at Hiromu's family home.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Big Brother
episodes.description: Hikari tries to be a good big brother to Hinata, but works a little too hard. Hiromu's parents try to make up for the years they've lost with their son and his family.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Home Visit
episodes.description: Masaki gathers his courage and brings his family and friends with him to his hometown, but things get awkward when he's confronted by his cousin Kazuhiko.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - I'm Home, Welcome Home
episodes.description: Masaki settles things with Kazuhiko, then takes his family to visit his parents' grave. Later, Hikari ventures forth on a new adventure: a solo errand.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Interweaving
episodes.description: Hikari wants to befriend the new neighbor's dog, but first he has to stop being scared of him. The family visits Masaki's uncle again, and Kazuhiko awkwardly tries to make conversation with Hiromu.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Tomato Kid
episodes.description: Masaki and Hikari encounter another new neighbor at the park: single father Mochizuki, who is trying to hold things together for his son Michiru after the loss of his spouse. Masaki offers to help.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Love
episodes.description: Mayhem ensues when Matsuo's younger twin brothers Yuto and Shuto drop by for a visit. First they zero in on befriending Hikari, then they set their sights on Yuki and his relationship to their older brother.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Bye-Bye?
episodes.description: Yuki tries to sort out his feelings toward Matsuo. Mochizuki finally gets the chance to meet Hiromu, but the meeting doesn't exactly go as nicely as Masaki was hoping it would.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - See You Tomorrow
episodes.description: After talking it out with Hiromu, Masaki attempts to reach out to Mochizuki and reach an understanding between them.

title: MEGATON MUSASHI
description: In 2118, 99.9% of humanity was wiped out by an invading alien force known as the Draktor. The survivors' memories are wiped before resuming life in fortified shelters. Humanity mounts an attack to take back the planet using giant robots known as Megaton-class Rogues. Yamato Ichidaiji is called to pilot one of the Rogues, just as memories of the invasion return and dangerous questions arise.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - Sleeping Lion
episodes.description: A resident of Akagicho, high-schooler Yamato finds himself locked up after starting a fight. His classmate, Teru, appears and makes him a deal. In exchange for getting him out of jail, he wants Yamato to take on a job for him. Yamato and his rival, Ryugo, head for the designated spot, but are set upon by thugs Teru riled up. When the two teens win the brawl, Teru takes them underground, where the boys are in for the shock of their lives.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - The Burning Earth
episodes.description: Yamato, Teru, and Ryugo board the Musashi and leave the shelter. Outside, they find a fierce battlefield against the aliens. Yamato and his team plunge into the fray and rack up victories thanks to Musashi's abilities. But the aliens' combat machines undergo a shocking transformation and their enemies turn the tables on them.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Assassin
episodes.description: Possessing Asuna's body, Arshem stalks Yamato in order to kill him, but fails when he notices her. In an attempt to maintain her cover, she lies and tells him she's in love with him. Later, Yamato and his teammates learn that one of the pilots has been assassinated.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Cat Tactics
episodes.description: Transfer student Reiji creeps out his classmates because he's always hanging out with cats. One day, while chasing a cat, he stumbles into Oblivion Bay. As if guided by some mysterious force, he climbs into the cockpit of the new Rogue. Then, with the cat still on board, the autopilot activates and takes off for the battlefield.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Secret Vow
episodes.description: In town, Yamato and his friends see a street gang that Ryugo has a history with. When they follow the gang into their secret hideout, they're surprised by who turns out to be the gang's boss. A fierce scuffle breaks out, but Reiji's appearance interrupts it. Yamato and his friends receive orders to report to base, so they head into battle alongside Reiji and fight together for the first time.

title: Trillion Game
description: Two old friends go into business together – one's a master communicator, and the other's a great engineer. Their goal? To make a trillion dollars.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - Episode 1
episodes.description: Charismatic college student Haru starts a company with his former classmate Gaku. In need of funds, they enter an elite computer hacking competition.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Episode 2
episodes.description: Haru and Gaku establish their company with Kedoin's investment. While interviewing prospective employees, they meet a particularly honest candidate.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Episode 3
episodes.description: As part of their strategy to secure a contract, Haru and Gaku start working at a Kabukicho host club but quickly make an enemy of its top earner.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Episode 4
episodes.description: Haru decides on Trillion Game's next money-making venture: a social network game. But first, he must find a company willing to develop one.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Episode 5
episodes.description: When Haru takes the game development funds in a bid to buy a talent agency, Gaku and the developers resolve to create a great game on their own.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Episode 6
episodes.description: Hebijima clashes with Sakura after arriving at Trillion Game. Haru and Kedoin turn to God Promotion shareholders in hopes of forcing Jin to step down.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Episode 7
episodes.description: After Trillion Game starts an internet TV channel, DragonBank counters by buying a major streaming service. Haru and Gaku meet with a news director.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Episode 8
episodes.description: When Kirika makes a bold move with D-REX, Haru pursues an exclusive streaming deal with a successful anime studio and its demanding director.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Episode 9
episodes.description: After giving an answer to Kokuryu's offer, Haru sets his sights on the cashless payment industry. Kokuryu transfers Kirika to a supermarket chain.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Episode 10
episodes.description: When Trillion Game suffers a data breach, Rinrin takes the fall. Kokuryu offers to buy out the company, but Haru counters with a proposal of his own.

title: You are Ms. Servant
description: Hitoyoshi, a high school kid who lives alone, hears a knock on his door. He opens it to find a strange girl offering to be his maid. She has beautiful black hair, graceful manners, and…a dark past as an assassin. But despite her deadly background and lack of household skills, Hitoyoshi takes her in. As she adjusts to her new life, she begins to experience emotions she’s never felt before.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - My Fateful Encounter With You.
episodes.description: A maid suddenly appears at the house of high school student Hitoyoshi Yokoya, asking to be hired. However, her background as a former assassin makes Hitoyoshi think twice. From this fateful encounter, their lives together will forever be changed.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - You Want to Know.
episodes.description: One day, Hitoyoshi is compelled to adopt a puppy that was left in front of his home. However, the maid has a childhood trauma involving dogs. Watching the two interact, the maid soon sees the world in a new light, even wishing to be "normal" herself.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - You Are Ms. Yuki.
episodes.description: Riko, Hitoyoshi's younger sister, pays him a visit to see the new puppy. As a lover of beautiful women, she easily gets along with Yuki despite her being a former assassin. In awe at Yuki's skills, she decides to use her for a school assignment.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - You Won't Miss Out.
episodes.description: To experience a "normal" school life, Yuki enrolls at the same school as Hitoyoshi. Seeing boys rush off, she finds out the school store sells a rare yakisoba bread. Yuki heads out the window, leaving Hitoyoshi to worry whether she'll fit in or not.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - What You Want to Protect.
episodes.description: After the Nitta incident, Yuki decides to become Hitoyoshi's bodyguard, sticking to him 24/7. When she is distracted for a moment, a woman named Grace appears and takes Hitoyoshi hostage, seeking to kill Yuki for prestige and revealing her dark past.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - You're Lonelier Than I Thought.
episodes.description: Finding enjoyment in teasing the former assassin, Grace returns as a gym teacher. After much harassment, she clues in Hitoyoshi of the changes occurring to Yuki. He now wants to know more about the maid as he sees her working hard to be normal.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - You've Finally Figured It Out.
episodes.description: Yuki is shocked to discover that maid outfits aren't considered normal. To make her feel better, Hitoyoshi takes her shopping for normal clothes. With the town decorated for Halloween, Yuki's world opens to new experiences, such as finding out her fears.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - The Autumn With You and the Sauce.
episodes.description: Yuki runs into misfortune as she finds out she won't be able to buy her favorite sauce for one week. With nightmares of the sauce and her sister, she must overcome challenges, including keeping her grades up to take part in the festivities at school.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - You and the Cultural Stage.
episodes.description: A Cops and Robbers event is to take place at the Katsuda Festival at Hitoyoshi’s school. The prideful President Hikage aims to win 2 years in a row. However, Naka decides to help Yuki beat her brother for acknowledgement, but also to make a friend.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - You and the Forbidden Fruit.
episodes.description: Hitoyoshi is pleased to see Yuki has made a new friend, Naka, but receives unfortunate news from his father that makes him upset. To make him feel better, Riko and Yuki both plan something special for Christmas that's sure to cheer him up… or maybe not?

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Your Prayers Are Gods' Prayers.
episodes.description: After realizing his feelings for Yuki, Hitoyoshi places a distance between himself and the Maid. Yuki finds herself crying nonstop, feeling rejected and incompetent with everything she does. With Naka's help, will Yuki be able to sort out her feelings?

episodes.title: Ep 12 - The Joyous Tidings You All Bring.
episodes.description: Consulting Naka, Yuki decides to select a birthday gift for Hitoyoshi. Meanwhile, Riko manages to wake up Hitoyoshi. Filled with fear and anxiety, he worries about what his dad would think of the real Yuki as he's about to face his biggest challenge.

title: Puniru Is a Kawaii Slime
description: The slime created by the boy Kotarou can transform into a super beautiful girl! Kotarou is constantly getting pushed around by Puniru's freewheeling antics. It's a joyful and exciting life every day!

episodes.title: Ep 1 - I HATE YOU and I LOVE YOU
episodes.description: Puniru follows Kotaro to school to take him something he forgot, but they end up getting into a fight. Puniru turns into an idol to get Kotaro to admit she’s cute. Kotaro tries to enlist Puniru’s help in winning the affections of his crush, Kirara-senpai.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Neither Friend nor Slime
episodes.description: Kotaro asks Puniru to turn into a first grader and act lost so he can look good in front of Kirara-senpai, but little does he know Kirara’s maternal instincts go into overdrive around children. Puniru later plays a trick using this knowledge.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Kawaii Puniru is a Slime
episodes.description: Kotaro’s favorite plushie as a child was the adorable Kyuthi-chan, which had a profound (jealous) effect on Puniru. Now he wants to go to the Kyuthi Café, where he gets Puniru to pretend to be his girlfriend so he can order a dish meant for couples.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Alice in Kyuthi Land
episodes.description: Alice, granddaughter to the president of the toy company that made Kyuthi-chan, challenges Puniru to see whether she or a character Alice created is more adorable—and you could say the competition gets blown into gigantic proportions!

episodes.title: Ep 5 - GO! GO! Fabulous Cheer Routine!
episodes.description: In an attempt to please Alice, Hodai dons a Runrune costume. Meanwhile, Nanpa, Puniru, and Hone-chan fight over Robo Runrune. Then, to put some pep back in the exhausted Kirara-senpai’s step, Puniru and Runrune become cheerleaders.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - The Runrune-tastic Grand Prix, Now with Puniru!
episodes.description: Puniru gets moldy and down in the dumps when Runrune starts ignoring her. Later, she’s determined to get Runrune and Alice to be friends again. Next, AI Runrune hits the scene, and Alice and Puniru face off to see which Runrune is better.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Sweet Bitter Summer
episodes.description: Kotaro and the boys go to the beach for a day of fun while Puniru and Kirara-senpai are at the school pool. Later, Kotaro asks Puniru to help him cool off with a special transformation, the gang hits a café, and then it’s time to tackle summer homework.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Gather 'Round for the School Festival!
episodes.description: It’s time for the school festival, but Puniru and Alice get into a fight over Kotaro. Alice tries to win him over with an incredible offer, and Puniru tries to throw the match so he can pursue his dreams.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Let's Start a Band, Punks!
episodes.description: Kotaro wants to be cool and decides to try his luck with dragons and a rock band. Puniru then lets the cat out of the bag about Kotaro’s feelings for Kirara, which forces him to make a move. Can he get Puniru to help him out?

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Merry Punirumas!
episodes.description: Ever since being teased as kid for liking cute things, Kotaro has never enjoyed Christmas. This year his parents are going on a trip for the holiday, so in order to avoid being stuck home alone with Puniru, he tries to throw a Christmas party.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Scoop Up a Spoonful of Christmas
episodes.description: Puniru says she’ll spend the holiday with whoever brings her the cutest Christmas cake, but the offerings she gets are... interesting. When a certain someone loses their patience, she may yet get a Christmas to remember.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - A Lovely, Puniful Destination
episodes.description: Out of the blue, Kotaro wins tickets to a ski resort—specifically the Runrune Resort run by Alice. When they get there, Puniru is determined to make an impression, and her desire to be cuter than ever may just spur even greater adventure.

episodes.title: Ep 13 - Puniru Returns
episodes.description: After Puniru goes missing in the middle of training to become cuter, Kotaro receives an unexpected package.

title: The Healer Who Was Banished from His Party, Is, in Fact, the Strongest
description: Two centuries have passed since a hero defeated the evil Jaryu and saved the world. In one of the many dungeon cities, Raust, a healer scorned and cast out of his party for being too weak, struggles to find his place. Amidst despair, he meets martial artist Narsena, who invites him to form a new party together. With a fresh start and renewed motivation, the two begin their journey to greatness.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - Regarding Their Meeting, Which Was, in Fact, a Reunion
episodes.description: A girl appears before Laust, an incompetent healer who has just been kicked out of his party. Introducing herself as Narsena, she turns to Saust and says, "Would you be willing to form a party with me?"

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Regarding the Banishment, Which Was, in Fact, the Start of a New Voyage
episodes.description: Laust had a very painful youth. Despite his best efforts as an adventurer, he was branded an "ignoramus" and lost confidence in himself. Then when wandering outside the city one day, he met a girl who inspired him to keep trying. But who exactly was she?

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Regarding the Mage, Who Is, in Fact, a Kind Soul
episodes.description: When Margulus, the leader of Blades of Lightning, finally admits Laust's talents and realizes how valuable the healer was to the party, he tries to recruit Laust again. However, Laust flatly refuses. The next day, Laust receives some unexpected visitors.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Regarding the Rescue, Which Is, in Fact, a Farewell
episodes.description: With a new swordsman beside him, Margulus stubbornly tries to slay the hydra again. The Blades of Lightning members slowly make progress against the monster, but by the time Laust arrives on the scene, the hydra has undergone a terrifying transformation.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Regarding the Meddling, Which Is, in Fact, a Reason for Concern
episodes.description: Laust starts to suspect that something ominous is happening involving monsters in the labyrinth and in Mardat. He asks Hanzum, the current head of the Guild, to take action. Hanzum refuses and tells Laust that if he is scared he should "get out of town."

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Regarding the Quest, Which Is, in Fact, the Start of a Comeback
episodes.description: Laust and his companions enter the labyrinth on their quest to battle the phoenix and earn the bounty from the Guild. They quickly track the phoenix down and engage it, but the instant they start causing damage to the fiery creature, it begins to mutate.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Regarding the Crossing of Paths, Which Was, in Fact, a Fateful Encounter
episodes.description: Now that they can afford it, Narsena suggests to Laust that it might be more practical to get a house and move in together—an invitation that is also a thinly-veiled expression of Narsena's love. Unfortunately, Laust's response is less than enthusiastic.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Regarding the Man, Who Was, in Fact, an Old Friend
episodes.description: Strange things continue to happen in Mardat's labyrinth. Laust, witnessing a new victim, once again requests for the guild to take action. However, once again, he is rejected by Hanzum. As Laust persists, Hansam asks, "Have you forgotten me completely?"

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Regarding the Master, Who Was, in Fact, the Apprentice
episodes.description: After a powerful earthquake shakes Mardat, waves of monsters start marching toward the city in a labyrinth uprising. Guild leadership quickly takes action. Suspicious that the Guild was expecting an uprising all along, Laust and friends ready for battle.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Regarding the Magician, Who Was, in Fact, a Two-Faced Liar
episodes.description: Laust, Narsena, and Ralma confront Mist and are told that to end the uprising, Ralma must commit all of her magic to creating a barrier while Mist and Hanzum hunt down the lord of the labyrinth. Ralma agrees but reminds Laust that Mist cannot be trusted.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Regarding the Uprising, Which Was, in Fact, the Beginning of Destruction
episodes.description: Laust learns that Narsena is in fact the sleeping princess. He and the others decide to follow Mist and Hanzum in an attempt to rescue her. When they finally locate Narsena and her captors deep inside the labyrinth, Mist begins to explain his intentions.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Regarding the Conclusion, Which Was, in Fact, the Start of a New Journey
episodes.description: With the evil dragon now inhabiting Mist's body, the second wave of the uprising approaches Mardat. Laust and his companions fight to defend the city, but when they find themselves overwhelmed by the dragon's powers, Narsena decides to sacrifice herself.

title: A Terrified Teacher at Ghoul School!
description: Haruaki Abe is happy to finally fulfill his dream of becoming a teacher. That happiness is short-lived after he arrives at Hyakki Academy and finds out the school is full of monsters! Can Abe overcome his cowardice and get his supernatural students under control? Join the timid teacher and his bizarre class for a tale of ghoulish mischief and paranormal education.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - Welcome to Hyakki Academy!
episodes.description: A loser teacher, Haruaki Abe, starts his new position at a school filled with youkai called Hyakki Academy. He then goes to visit a shut-in zashikiwarashi named Beniko so everyone can be included in the class picture.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Physical Exams Are Life-Threatening?!
episodes.description: Hyakki Academy is in a panic because of the upcoming physical exams. Haruaki has trouble doing the cyclops Rensuke's eye exam and getting the daidarabocchi Oota's height. But further misfortune falls upon him as he's also tasked with cleaning the pool...

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Panic! In Miki-sensei's Youkai Studies Class!!
episodes.description: Haruaki is invited to observe Miki's youkai studies class but things immediately get hectic when Miki decides to demonstrate his powers by having a little bit of sake...

episodes.title: Ep 4 - An Interview with Haruaki?! Here Comes Youkai TV!
episodes.description: Youkai TV wants to do an up-close-and-personal interview with Haruaki?! Of course, he has trouble during an extracurricular lesson and his students try to make him look good but it fails! Will this thing actually air?

episodes.title: Ep 5 - I Know. Let's Go to Sensei's Family Home.
episodes.description: Haruaki goes back to his family home, but then a few of the students decide to visit him there. While they're there, the students meet Haruaki's older brother, Amaaki, who seems to dislike youkai.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Sports Day at Ghoul School!! ~Commences~
episodes.description: It's Sports Day at Hyakki Academy! A scavenger hunt relay, mandragora toss... plenty of youkai-themed events! A fiery battle over Class 2-3's victory and Haruaki's xxxx begins now!

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Sports Day at Ghoul School!! ~Finishes~
episodes.description: It's Sports Day at Hyakki Academy part 2! Class 2-3 is struggling at 3rd place, but they're trying to get to 1st place with the obstacle course relay. But an accident occurs and steers the event into an unexpected direction.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Amaaki, Momoyama-san, and the Nudity Festival
episodes.description: Amaaki, Haruaki's twin brother, takes his place and becomes a teacher for a day. Soon after, Yanagida's love potion cause havoc at the school. And to finish the episode off, the whole class goes to a public bath.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Save Me, Seimei-kun! The Case of the Animal Youkai Abductions!!
episodes.description: Numerous cases where animal youkai are getting abducted and having their fur shaved off occur! Mamekichi, Tamao, and Hatanaka also disappear so Haruaki and Sano try to save them. Will Haruaki be able to save his furry friends in this mysterious case?

episodes.title: Ep 10 - School Camp of Terror
episodes.description: This episode involved a huge event: a school camp! Or rather, it ended up being a final exam for spookology. Can the students safely get through the old school building and the various trials that await?

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Parent-Teacher Conference from Hell!
episodes.description: Haruaki does some parent-teacher conferences, but of course, the parents are also youkai, so they don't go very smoothly. On the way home, he scouts Kyoto with Miki and Hatanaka for a future school trip but then they all remember a certain incident...

episodes.title: Ep 12 - The Great Tokyo Haruaki Search!!
episodes.description: Kaminarimon and Tokyo Tower! Class 2-3's excitement over their Tokyo field trip comes to a sudden halt when Haruaki gets swept away by a wave of salarymen into the subway and gets lost. The students split up to find him but Sano gets a really bad feeling.

episodes.title: Ep 13 - The Cursed Secondhand Book
episodes.description: Summer vacation is finally here! Hijita and Rensuke enjoy Beniko's special shaved ice, while Mamekichi and Tamao go catch some bugs. Meanwhile, Haruaki goes to a bookstore where Sano works and is recommended a book but that ends up causing havoc!

episodes.title: Ep 14 - Zashiki-san's Bed-and-Breakfast Home
episodes.description: During the middle of summer vacation, Beniko's family home that's a bed and breakfast is going to be featured in an occult magazine. Beniko and her friends work together to spook the scientist that the reporter brought along to disprove her home being supernatural.

episodes.title: Ep 15 - Abe no Seimei, Haruaki Abe, and Shutendouji
episodes.description: Summer vacation still continues! Haruaki is invited to Miki's family home in Mount Ooe. There, he finds out Rintarou's dark past and ends up having to fight a great enemy.

episodes.title: Ep 16 - The Great Hyakki Academy Island Chase!!
episodes.description: Officer Yamazaki, the doppelganger police officer of Hyakki Academy Island, tries to protect the peace by capturing a teketeke robber.

episodes.title: Ep 17 - Summer! The Ocean! Huh? It's Already August 31st...
episodes.description: Class 2-3 enjoys some time at the beach during their summer vacation and Haruaki and Sano learn about youkai births.

episodes.title: Ep 18 - The Temporary Teacher, Ebisu-sensei
episodes.description: A new teacher named Ebisu-sensei, who is a god of fortune, comes to teach at Hyakki Academy for a short time.

episodes.title: Ep 19 - Welcome to the Youkai Train
episodes.description: Haruaki and some of the kids in Class 2-3 take the train to go shopping but there's something off about the train.

episodes.title: Ep 20 - The Night Parade Cultural Festival
episodes.description: The Night Parade Cultural Festival at Hyakki Academy begins!

episodes.title: Ep 21 - The Underground Night Parade Cultural Festival
episodes.description: Haruaki goes with Tamao to get some equipment for the cultural fair but something goes wrong.

episodes.title: Ep 22 - Goodbye, Ren-Ren
episodes.description: Nyuudou suddenly announces that he's leaving school so Haruaki and the class try to stop him.

episodes.title: Ep 23 - The Gashadokuro, Kuniko Utagawa
episodes.description: Haruaki and his class continue their efforts to get Nyuudou back and Utagawa reveals a secret about herself.

episodes.title: Ep 24 - The Bond Continuing with Ren-Ren. The Teacher from Ghoul School Will Do His Best!
episodes.description: Haruaki and his students continue to do their best to get Nyuudou back.

title: TsumaSho
description: Keisuke Niijima has lived in grief since his wife, Takae, passed away 10 years ago. But when a young girl visits, claiming to be Takae reincarnated, Keisuke and his daughter, Mai, are drawn into a miraculous reunion. As the girl reveals intimate details only they could know, the Niijima family slowly begins to heal, rediscovering love and warmth in the most unexpected way.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - A Family Again
episodes.description: Keisuke fell in love with Takae when they met through work. They got married and had a daughter, Mai, before Takae was tragically killed in an accident. Ten years later, an elementary school student appears on Keisuke's doorstep saying, "I am your wife!"

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Right Now
episodes.description: Keisuke and Mai are thrilled that Takae has returned to them, even if it is in the body of a grade schooler. They devote themselves to making up for lost time together. Meanwhile, Takae is dealing with family issues in her other life as a fourth grader.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - One Step Forward
episodes.description: Mai starts working at a new job but gets depressed after struggling to connect with her first client. To cheer her up, Takae invites her to see a fireworks show. Keisuke decides to stop by as well and happens to bump into his coworker Moriya on the way.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Chatting Together
episodes.description: Mai is on her second date with Renji Aikawa, who then asks her to show him around Tokyo. Additionally, Chika, the mother of Marika (also known as Takae), has been seeing a man more frequently. Marika is now also supposed to get to know him.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Mother and Family
episodes.description: Takae is nervous to tell Keisuke and Mai about Chika's plans to move and remarry, but the two take the news fairly well since the family will still be able to meet. Takae tries to stay positive about the move and hopes it will bring her mother happiness.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Memories, Creaking
episodes.description: After seeing Marika (Takae) with Keisuke and Mai, Chika presses her daughter for an explanation. Takae's reluctance to respond sends Chika into a rage. Keisuke witnesses the outburst and starts trying to think of a way to help Takae leave her toxic home.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - A Sign of Happiness
episodes.description: Mai and Keisuke receive a surprise visit from Renji. Keisuke is shocked to learn that Mai has a boyfriend and depressed to realize that she might eventually move out. Moriya notices Keisuke's mood at work and tries to think of a way to help cheer him up.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Who Are You?
episodes.description: Chika and the Niijimas work together to support Marika after her memory loss. Mai tutors Marika to help her with school while Chika continues to work toward becoming a better mother. Meanwhile, Keisuke is worried that he may have lost his wife yet again.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - I Want to Share How I Feel
episodes.description: Takae regains her memories and discovers the truth. Takae asks Chika to call her "Marika" to make things easier for when Marika eventually returns. When Keisuke hears about this, he suspects the same, but he still finds the idea very difficult to accept.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - If That Is Your Wish
episodes.description: Keisuke explains the situation with his wife to Moriya, who is upset to hear that Keisuke wants to stay away from Takae for her own sake. Meanwhile, Takae joins Mai and Renji on a tour of the wedding venue and uses the occasion to make a special request.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Love You More Than Anyone
episodes.description: Mai becomes very distraught when Keisuke tells her that he and Moriya plan to marry. Keisuke explains that Takae has merely possessed Marika and is eager to return the body to its owner. Mai refuses to accept this and turns to her mother for reassurance.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - One Moment
episodes.description: Mai takes Takae to the amusement park where Keisuke first ate one of Takae's bentos. On the Ferris wheel, Takae thanks Mai for her kindness and then notices Keisuke and Moriya walking below. Takae then witnesses as Keisuke makes a life-changing decision.

title: Bananya
description: Bananya is a series about the secret life of kitties who live in bananas.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - The Kitty Who Lives in a Banana
episodes.description: Meet the adorable kitty who lives inside a banana!

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Bananya and Friends, Nya
episodes.description: Meet the adorable kitty who lives inside a banana!

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Bananya Watches TV, Nya
episodes.description: Bananya spends some time channel surfing with the help of Baby Bananya.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Bananya and the Mouse, Nya
episodes.description: Bananya is busy doing cat things when he spots a mouse! Will his cat instincts take over?!

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Bananya and the Refrigerator, Nya!
episodes.description: When someone in the house leaves the refrigerator door open, Bananya and friends can't resist taking a look inside...

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Bananya Goes Out, Nya
episodes.description: Bananya falls asleep in Mama's purse, and she unknowingly takes him to the supermarket!

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Bananya in the Middle of the Night, Nya
episodes.description: Bananya and his friends explore the house late at night, when the dark, quiet atmosphere makes everything look different...

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Bananya and the Stray Cat, Nya
episodes.description: Bananya wakes from an afternoon nap to find a visitor peering in the window...

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Bananya in the Bathroom, Nya
episodes.description: Bananya and his friends discover the bathroom, where they're once again up to their usual mischief.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Bananya and the Balloon, Nya
episodes.description: A balloon quietly floats in the living room, and the bananyas can't resist trying to grab it. But everyone knows cats and balloons are a dangerous combination...

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Bananya Takes a Walk, Nya
episodes.description: Bananya is bored, so he heads outside for a walk and a visit to a neighbor's house.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Bananya's Afternoon Nap, Nya
episodes.description: Bananya is taking an afternoon nap, but some of his friends have other ideas...

episodes.title: Ep 13 - Bananya and the Birthday, Nya
episodes.description: The mother of the household is busily preparing for a birthday party... and the bananyas decide to help!

title: How I Attended an All-Guy's Mixer
description: Three guys meet three cute boys who are actually women in drag! They soon find themselves getting closer in unexpected ways.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - That Time I Went to a Mixer and...
episodes.description: Three guys meet three cute boys at a mixer with no girls?!

episodes.title: Ep 2 - That Time I Went to the Bar and...
episodes.description: Tokiwa and the others go to the drag bar for the first time.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - That Time I Went to an Izakaya and...
episodes.description: Kohaku invites Hagi to hang out. Fuji asks Asagi to come over to her place so he can do her a favor.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - That Time I Went to the Zoo and...
episodes.description: Suo says the gang should hang out this weekend, so Tokiwa, Asagi, and Hagi go to their rendezvous spot without knowing exactly where they’re going.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - That Time I Went to a Comic Convention and...
episodes.description: Fuji invites Asagi to a “festival.” But when he gets there, Asagi finds out he is actually at a comic convention.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - That Time I Went to Your Place and...
episodes.description: While talking to Kohaku at the bar, Hagi realizes he has romantic feelings for her.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - That Time I Went Camping and...
episodes.description: The six friends arrive at a campsite. The gang enjoys a barbecue in the great outdoors.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - That Time I Went to Campus and...
episodes.description: Tokiwa takes a walk with a non-cross-dressing Suo. Meanwhile, Asagi is alone with Fuji at the Bar Rose.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - That Time I Went to a Summer Festival and...
episodes.description: Hagi invites Kohaku to a summer festival. The other four members of the gang also go to the festival to watch them from the shadows.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - That Time You Went to My Place and...
episodes.description: Asagi decides he wants to learn how to be cool because of something Fuji said to him. Fuij notices something weird is up with Asagi.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - That Time I Went to the Beach and...
episodes.description: At Kohaku’s request, her friends help her out at a beach house. Meanwhile, Suo wants to have some fun in the sun and takes Tokiwa along with her.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - That Time I Went to a Mixer and... (Thought I'd Never Need to Go to Another Mixer Again)
episodes.description: Hagi confides in Kohaku about his recent emotional turmoil. Later, Tokiwa goes sightseeing by himself and runs into Suo.

title: BLUE LOCK
description: High school soccer players from across Japan gather for a controversial project designed to create the best — and most egoistic — striker in the world.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - Dream
episodes.description: Isagi Yoichi, a first-year forward, loses his chance for the Nationals because he has passed the ball to his fellow player in front of the goal. That's when he receives an invitation for Blue Lock. It's a facility to train one world's greatest striker out of 300 high-school-aged forwards so that Japan can win the World Cup.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Monster
episodes.description: Kira is eliminated from Blue Lock, and with that, the first day at the Blue Lock that promises to create the greatest center forward in the world begins in Isagi Yoichi 's life.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Soccer's "Zero"
episodes.description: The first selection is the round-robin tournament of five teams of V, W, X, Y and Z in Building Five, with only top two teams being eligible to move forward. Isagi's Team Z, the lowest ranking team, plays against Team X. But because of the special rule that allows the top scorer of the team to proceed to the next section, the match turns into chaotic scrambling for the ball, regardless of the teams. It was Barou Shoei, Team X's formidable striker, who changes the flow of the game.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Premonition and Intuition
episodes.description: Team Z was crushed by Team X, who centered the offensive play around egoistical yet skilled Barou. Responding to Ego's urge to "take up a weapon," the players discuss what their weapons are in preparation for the next match. However, Isagi struggles to identify what it is. Using "the smell of the goal" he felt in the game against Team X as a hint, Isagi and the others go against Team Y in the next match.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - To Be Reborn
episodes.description: Isagi relies on "the smell of the goal," his raw instincts, to make a move, and it leads to the fierce battle of "reading" each other's hand with Team Y's playmaker, Niko Ikki. Isagi and Niko's battle as they both watch over the whole field and throw their ego at each other, brings them to the last one minute of the match. Can Isagi and Team Z beat Niko's final strategy, "One Time Kill Counter"?

episodes.title: Ep 6 - I'm Sorry
episodes.description: After the match with Team Y, Isagi's rank moved up, and he became the center of the team. The next match is against Team W, led by the Wanima twins. Their eye contact and impeccable combinations are hard to beat. They used to play in the same team as Chigiri Hyoma, and they use his past trauma to egg him on. Chigiri says that he joined Blue Lock to find a reason to quit soccer. Team Z leads the game with Kuon's play. Everyone's elated for the good start of the match, but Isagi feels something is off.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Rush
episodes.description: Because of Kuon’s betrayal, Team Z is faced with a desperate situation of playing 12-on-10, with the opponent knowing everything about their weapons and strategies. Even under such a circumstance, Team Z never gives up on the fight, and Isagi continues to believe in himself. Inspired by their passion, Chigiri runs through the field at an incredible speed, his weapon he has sealed away. His ego rocks the match when they are losing at 3-4.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - The Formula for Goals
episodes.description: The Z team has only one game left to play, and it will decide the future of its members. While everyone seems to be nervous about the kickoff, Isagi is trying to find a way to score goals without anyone's help.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Awakening
episodes.description: The match continues to leave Team Z scared of Nagi's abilities. However, one of the members is not scared, even though they are facing a soccer genius...?

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Just the Way It Is
episodes.description: Each player unleashed their weapon and ego, and Team Z has caught up to a draw. They totally have the momentum of the game, but that has “awakened” Team V’s monster, Nagi. In the chain reaction to awakening, Isagi also learns to use his weapon and keeps fighting. The “heat” generated by the clashing of ego from both teams starts to affect Kuon as well.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - The Final Piece
episodes.description: Team Z launches a final counter to try and win against Team V. Isagi is trying to find the last piece he needs to crack the formula to become a goal machine.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - The Second Selection
episodes.description: With many dropouts, the "Blue Lock" project enters the second selection. A harsh second selection where former friends become rivals and former enemies become allies at a dizzying pace. There, Isagi meets Rin, the most powerful egoist ever, the younger brother of the genius Itoshi Sae, and the new Blue Lock ranking TOP ranker. Seeking further evolution, Isagi's fight advances to a new stage.

episodes.title: Ep 13 - TOP3
episodes.description:
In this new stage of the second selection, the white team formed by Isagi, Nagi and Bachira will finally go against the top three in the ranking of the previous stage, running the risk of losing one of their three players if they lose the game. Still, the willingness to test their new skills against the top three is much stronger in the white team members.

Will they be able to win this match?

episodes.title: Ep 14 - The Geniuses and the Average Joes
episodes.description: The loss of Bachira on his team makes Isagi very anxious about what his future with Nagi will be like. To make matters worse, the situation is now even more complex: the ideal would be to go against a weaker team, but that would mean taking a weaker player too, which would make it more difficult to advance the next stages. So what are Isagi and Nagi going to do?

episodes.title: Ep 15 - Devour
episodes.description: Isagi realizes that the conclusion of the match is in his and Naruhaya's hands. However, how will he go about beating Naruhaya? This will be a game that will not depend on genius players, but on "mediocre" players.
