title: The Foolish Angel Dances with the Devil
description: Determined to protect his demon world from heavenly angels, demon Masatora Akutsu heads to earth in search of a charismatic human to rally his kin. Masquerading as a high schooler for his recruitment mission, he's captivated by the lovely Lily Amane. But he's in for a wild celestial surprise, because she's his archnemesis—an angel—and she's set on reforming his demonic ways!

episodes.title: Ep 1 - The Foolish Angel and the Demon
episodes.description: Akutsu Masatora transfers to a new school, where he falls for the beautiful and kind Amane Lily on sight. But Akutsu has a dark secret, and a mission... and Lily might be more than meets the eye, as well!

episodes.title: Ep 2 - The Even More Foolish Angel and Demon
episodes.description: Lily and Akutsu both have everything to prove as they embark upon their new, fraught relationship dynamic. Who will come out on top in the battle for dominance?!

episodes.title: Ep 3 - The Still Foolish Angel and Demon
episodes.description: The first demon-hunting expedition by Lily and Akutsu turns up nothing... except for Yuka, a childhood friend of Hirota's who sees Lily as a rival for his affections!

episodes.title: Ep 4 - The Equally Foolish Angel and Demon
episodes.description: When Lily tracks down a spats-obsessed demon, Akutsu does everything within his power to distract her from the battle. Later, Akutsu's boss visits and demands he work on his game to better recruit a new leader for Hell.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - The Excited Foolish Angel and Demon
episodes.description: Lily uses her adorableness to the fullest as she tries to manipulate Akutsu into falling for her. She finds her efforts matched by Akutsu, and it quickly turns into a flirtatious battle for the ages.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - The Panicked Foolish Angel and Demon
episodes.description: Lily must navigate a terrifying nightmare to wake up and return to class. When Akutsu requests to have the collar removed to more easily enjoy simple pleasures, unexpected consequences throw both him and Lily into combat.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - The Exposed Foolish Angel and Demon
episodes.description: Akutsu stands by Lily and spends the night at her place. Lily gets incredibly flustered at the idea of rewarding Akutsu for his efforts but refuses to go back on a promise she made in the past.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - The Misunderstanding Foolish Angel and Demon
episodes.description: Lily and Akutsu must deal with the social fallout surrounding Akutsu being spotted leaving Lily's apartment. They execute intricate plans to convince everyone that they don't have feelings for each other.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - The Happy Foolish Angel and Demon
episodes.description: With Lily sick and bedridden, her avatar comes to school claiming to be  her older sister "Lilia." She quickly convinces faculty to let her stay for the day and is a hit among the students.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - The False Foolish Angel and Demon
episodes.description: Lily's brother, Zwei, comes to visit. When he first runs into Lily and Akutsu, he's pleasant and cordial. However, his tone quickly shifts when he thinks he's alone with Lily.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - The Foolish Angel and Demon Spread Their Wings
episodes.description: Overwhelmed with rage and disgust at the mistreatment of Lily, Akutsu manifests black wings and attacks Zwei. However, it quickly becomes apparent that even Lily isn't safe from Akutsu in his blind rage.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - The Foolish Angel and Demon to the End

title: Tales of Wedding Rings
description: Sato is a high school boy in love with his best friend Hime, an unearthly beauty from another realm. So when she moves back to her home world to get married, Sato doesn’t think twice—he follows her and crashes the wedding. Then, after a kiss from Hime, he suddenly becomes the new groom! But here, Hime is a Ring Princess and her husband is destined to be the Ring King: a hero of immense power.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - Episode 1
episodes.description: Satou, an ordinary male student, was unable to confess his love to his childhood friend, Hime, but one day she suddenly announces she's moving far away. Satou chases after Hime and follows her through a gate of light into another world known as Arnulus!

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Episode 2
episodes.description: Satou has married Hime and become the legendary Ring King who will save Arnulus from the threat of the Abyss King. They struggle to advance their relationship, but there's no time to enjoy their newlywed life as the Abyss King's pursuers close in.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Episode 3
episodes.description: Satou and the others have arrived in the elven homeland of Romca, the Land of Wind where he plans to marry Nefritis, princess of the Ring of Wind. Due to her shy nature, Nefritis vehemently refuses her marriage to Satou.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Episode 4
episodes.description: With the belief that the Abyss King's armies are closing in, Alabaster suggests they postpone Satou's marriage to Nefritis and head to another country. As they're departing an Abyss King's knight makes it past the barrier and attacks Romca.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Episode 5
episodes.description: Satou and company continue their journey for the next ring. Hime becomes jealous of Satou taking care of Nephritis. Soon after, a large caravan appears before them which is the Land of Fire, Needakitta. They ask for an audience with the princess, but...

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Episode 6
episodes.description: Satou trains with Marse, hoping to beat Granart in the sword duel to court her. Satou is torn between facing her fairly to look cool for Hime, and prioritizing his duty as the Ring King. However, the Abyss King's evil clutches are approaching Needakitta.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Episode 7
episodes.description: Satou visits Maasa, the Land of Water, and unexpectedly ends up marrying Saphir, the Ring Princess. Saphir believes she needs the Ring King's power to save her homeland from being controlled by the Gisaras Empire.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Episode 8
episodes.description: The oracle who's secretly running Maasa the Land of Water offers some advice to Marse who failed in his mission. Satou and Sluder prepare to repel the approaching Abyss King's horde. As Satou struggles, a certain person suddenly stands before him.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Episode 9
episodes.description: Peace has returned to Maasa and the gang are able to take a short break. Satou and Hime go on a date alone, but Nefritis, Granart, and Saphir secretly follow them. Satou and Hime are enjoying their date, but then they recall Alabaster's prior words.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Episode 10
episodes.description: Satou and his friends head to Idanokan, the Land of Earth. However, having previously been destroyed in a battle with the Abyss King, the dwarves have abandoned the city. As the group searches for the Ring Princess that which they feared most occurs.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Episode 11
episodes.description: Satou and his friends have arrived in Satou's world with no way to return to Arnulus. Satou suffers from being unable to fulfill his duty as Ring King when Amber, the Ring Princess of Idanokan, the Land of Earth, appears before him.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Episode 12
episodes.description: Satou and his friends return to Arnulus among countless corpses of imperial soldiers and monsters. Satou encounters the Abyss King in a hopeless situation. Using the Ring Princesses' power he challenges the Abyss King in a confrontation to save Arnulus!

title: TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy-
description: Makoto Misumi is just an ordinary high school student living a regular life, but all of a sudden gets summoned to the other world to become a "hero." The goddess of the other world, however, insults him for being different and strips his "hero" title, before casting him off to the wilderness at the edge of the world. As he wanders the wilderness, Makoto encounters dragons, spiders, orcs, dwarves, and all sorts of non-human tribes. Because Makoto comes from a different world, he is able to unleash unimaginable magical powers and combat skills. But just how will he handle his encounters with various species and survive in his new environment. In this fantasy, Makoto tries to transform the other world into a better place despite the humans and gods having turned their backs on him.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - What? Moon over the Ruined Castle?
episodes.description: Mikoto and Shiki are making their way to Rotsgard Academy in hopes of opening a new store. Meanwhile, back in the demiplane, everyone is helping Mio practice her cooking skills by taste-testing her dishes.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - The Heroes Are a Couple of Beauties
episodes.description: We meet one of Misumi Makoto's classmates back on earth, who also has a curious encounter with a certain goddess who presides over a certain isekai. She and one other are sent there as heroes to help the hyumans defeat the demons.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Stellar Wars
episodes.description: Hibiki and Tomoki's parties prepare for the attack on Fort Stella (the one Makoto ended up being somewhat involved in against his will). The two human heroes couldn't be more different, posing challenges beyond the simple difficulty of facing the demons.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Why Am I a Teacher?!
episodes.description: Makoto finally arrives in Rotsgard, but is shocked to find that he's somehow ended up registered to take a teacher's exam instead of one for students. On the way there, he crosses paths with some haughty students of the school...

episodes.title: Ep 5 - The Lesson Will Now Begin
episodes.description: Makoto starts planning his curriculum and class size now that he's employed at Rotsgard Academy. He wants to teach students to expand their use of elemental magic, but his first class seems to think that's simply impossible.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Becoming a Three-Star Chef
episodes.description: Makoto is finally able to open his new shop in Rotsgard, but convincing staff to work there rather than Tsige is a bit of a challenge. He later has a talk with Eva about this world's view of marriage, which doesn't sit well with him.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - New Member Audition
episodes.description: Makoto returns to the demiplane to check out his new house, which has finally completed construction. He arrives to find that the weather is unseasonably hot, and the source of the problem might be his fault.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - The Notorious Beautiful Sisters
episodes.description: Makoto had a busy but fun time in the demiplane. After finishing his business, he returns to Rotsgard with Shiki. Meanwhile, at Rotsgard Academy, Shifu and Yuno Rembrandt have returned to school and will attend a lecture with transfer student Karen Force.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - The Perverted Dragon
episodes.description: Lime sets out to investigate hyuman experiments that are secretly being carried out in Rotsgard. He ends up being captured by an underground organization along with Eva. After that, the two manage to escape and meet up with Shin and the others.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Watch as I Improve the World
episodes.description: Shin and company begin full-scale action to destroy the underground organization with demon general Rona's help. The group discovers that the mastermind is Bright, an instructor at Rotsgard Academy. Bright's willingness to make sacrifices angers Makoto.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Summer of Growth and New Skills
episodes.description: It's summer vacation for Rotsgard Academy. Makoto spends his time doing miscellaneous work and learning magic. One day it's decided he will have a mock battle against the wingkin. Makoto braces himself against his powerful enemies who are undefeated.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Attack of the Giant Monsters
episodes.description: One day near summer's end, the highland orcs are attacked by wolves and bears while exploring the forest. After hearing the news, Makoto goes to the forest in an attempt to make peace between them, but the bear he meets looks upon him with hostility.

episodes.title: Ep 13 - The Very Busy Academy Festival
episodes.description: The academy festival is fast approaching. Shinai, a temple priest, arranges a meeting with Makoto on short notice. Shinai informs Makoto about rumors concerning the medicine being sold at the shop and offers Makoto a proposal to help dispel them.

episodes.title: Ep 14 - I'm Not a Fan of High Society
episodes.description: Makoto attends a luncheon on the second day of the festival and is approached by Sairitsu, an official with the Laurel Commonwealth. She suspects Makoto may be from another world because of the foreign characters on the Kuzunoha Trading Company's sign.

episodes.title: Ep 15 - A Fierce Tournament
episodes.description: Students take on the individual competition in the school festival's highlight event, the combat tournament. Due to a nobleman plot, they are forced to face off against their peers. Jin advances to the finals and faces off against Ilumgand Hopleys.

episodes.title: Ep 16 - A Certain Student's Secret
episodes.description: Due to the incident with Zara, Makoto decides to join the demons, and after witnessing the fighting tournament, he decides to leave Rotsgard. The next day, Jin and his friends advance to the finals of the team competition and face a team led by Ilumgand.

episodes.title: Ep 17 - Mutation Hazard
episodes.description: Ilumgand was transformed into a monster. Jin and Abelia launch an attack to stop him. However, their attacks have no effect, and they lose their fighting spirit and energy in the face of an enemy stronger than ever.

episodes.title: Ep 18 - Fall of the Academy City
episodes.description: Rotsgard's turmoil continues. Numerous mutants have appeared in the city and Jin and his friends attempt to subjugate them. Meanwhile, Mio, who has been ordered by Makoto to protect the shelter, detects a strange smell from Makoto during her mission.

episodes.title: Ep 19 - The Unruly Merchant
episodes.description: The mutant turmoil shows no signs of ending. At the evacuation center, people who've transformed into new mutants have appeared, anxiety and fatigue have reached their peak. To change the situation, Misumi's group joins the mutant subjugation force.

episodes.title: Ep 20 - The Utterly Hateable Good-for-Nothing
episodes.description: Using the mutant disturbance as a decoy the demon army advances on the Kingdom of Limia and the Empire of Gritonia. The hyuman army tries to intercept them, but are quickly outnumbered and overpowered. The two great powers are on the verge of collapse.

episodes.title: Ep 21 - The Heroes Fight Bravely
episodes.description: Tomoe, Mio, and the residents of the demiplane are ordered by Makoto to take back Kaleneon, and enter enemy territory. Meanwhile, in the Gritonia Empire, Tomoki and his friends head to the battlefield, where they encounter Sofia standing in their way.

episodes.title: Ep 22 - Fight On, Hero!
episodes.description: Makoto is shaken by the revelation that the hero he meets on the battlefield is his high school senior, Hibiki Otonashi. Unable to dwell on it, Makoto enters a battle with Io to whom he suggests the demons retreat, in order to avoid a pointless battle

episodes.title: Ep 23 - Rival Revenge Match
episodes.description: Sofia suddenly barges into the battle between Makoto and Io. Having longed for a rematch with Makoto, Sofia launches a fierce attack on her nemesis as soon as she steps onto the battlefield. Despite being outnumbered, Makoto appears unfazed.

episodes.title: Ep 24 - Sorcerer vs. Draconid
episodes.description: Outside Limia's royal castle, a fierce battle between Shiki and Mitsurugi unfolds. Meanwhile, inside the castle, the battle between Makoto and Sofia continues. Sofia, at a loss, unleashes her secret weapon.

episodes.title: Ep 25 - Party Beneath the Moonlight
episodes.description: After the battle in Limia, Makoto returns to the demiplane where he is welcomed by Tomoe, Mio and the residents of the demiplane. After a short celebration Makoto returns to Rotsgard to wipe out the remaining mutants, ending the days-long turmoil.

title: 'Tis Time for "Torture," Princess
description: As the war between the Imperial Army and Hellhorde rages on, the Princess, despite being armed with her mythical sword Excalibur, is captured and imprisoned. What kind of torture does she face at the hands of the chief demon interrogator? Fluffy fresh-baked toast! Hot, steaming ramen! Oh, the humanity! Can the Princess withstand these tormenting treats and keep her kingdom’s secrets safe?

episodes.title: Ep 1 - Episode 1
episodes.description: The princess of the Royal Empire finds herself imprisoned by the demonic Hellhorde, but she resists with an iron will. That is, until the Grand Inquisitor decides to resort to more unusual forms of torture...

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Episode 2
episodes.description: Our noble princess is faced with a number of new faces out to torment her, including a demonic duo of oni, a tamer commanding barbaric beasts, and a towering titan of terror.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Episode 3
episodes.description: The princess endures cruel torture in the form of an amusement park trip, bubble wrap, and soup dumplings. Fortunately, a white knight in shining armor shows up to rescue her.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Episode 4
episodes.description: Torture Tortura is tested on her torture techniques, as she attempts to tantalize the terrifying Hell-Lord. Elsewhere, Ex experiences the excruciating ecstasy usually executed upon the princess.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Episode 5
episodes.description: The fearless princess must contend with the horror of roasted marshmallows, sweltering saunas, and haunted school buildings. Meanwhile, an old foe lies in wait to exact his revenge...

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Episode 6
episodes.description: The Hell-Lord rewards Maomao-chan for her promotion. Meanwhile, the princess faces the horrors of gooey cheese, a routine physical, and the return of her loyal White Knight.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Episode 7
episodes.description: The princess faces a two-pronged assault from a pair of adorable kitties. Maomao-chan competes in the annual field day at her preschool as her family and friends cheer her on.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Episode 8
episodes.description: Youki and Inki take on the torturer promotion exam. Giant invites the princess out on a night stroll. And a new member of the Hellhorde shows up to teach the princess what real torture is!

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Episode 9
episodes.description: Torture enjoys some downtime in her hotel room after a long day on a business trip. Maomao-chan bakes cookies for the very first time. The princess is tortured with tea and cake.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Episode 10
episodes.description: Torture takes the Princess to the beach to torture her with heated combat for a chance at freedom.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Episode 12
episodes.description: Vanilla invites Princess out on a playdate. The princess catches a cold. Torture worries about a corporate shake-up. And the Hell-Lord wakes up to find himself in a strange new world...

title: Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?!
description: After remaining a virgin for 30 years, Kiyoshi Adachi gains the ability to read other people's minds by touching them.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - Episode 1
episodes.description: 30 year old Kiyoshi Adachi is an office worker who recently acquired the power to read people's minds through touch. He accidentally touches Yuichi Kurosawa, his most attractive co-worker, finding out that Yuichi is in love with Kiyoshi himself.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Episode 2
episodes.description: After missing the last train, Adachi stays over at Kurosawa's house. While Adachi is excited because he's had no prior experience with love, Kurosawa still keeps his attraction to himself and maintains an awkward atmosphere. Adachi seeks advice from his best friend, novelist Masato Tsuge.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Episode 3
episodes.description: After hearing the thoughts of Kurosawa, Adachi learns that his romantic feelings for him are genuine. The office goes drinking together at Rokkaku's invitation, and Adachi and Kurosawa suddenly find themselves much closer. Meanwhile, a courier arrives at Tsuge's house. When he opens the door, the unfriendly deliveryman Minato is standing there...

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Episode 4
episodes.description: Two weeks have passed since the incident between Adachi and Kurosawa; Adachi gets desperate. While shopping with Fujisaki, Adachi is violently confronted, but is saved by a friend who reveals his true intentions.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Episode 5
episodes.description: While Kurosawa has trouble with a client, Adachi uses his power to help him for the first time. Adachi discovers some truths about Kurosawa which upset him.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Episode 6
episodes.description: Kurosawa takes care of Adachi, and decides to spend the night. Kurosawa begins to doubt his own feelings for Adachi. Tsuge takes desperate measures to meet the unfriendly courier.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Episode 7
episodes.description: Kurosawa finally confesses his feelings for Adachi, but wants to restore their relationship to a state before this confession. Kurosawa reflects on the reason for his attraction to Adachi; meanwhile, Adachi makes a certain decision.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Episode 8
episodes.description: Adachi and Kurosawa begin dating. Adachi acts like it's business as usual at the office, but he can't keep his heart from pounding every time he talks to Kurosawa. Eventually, Kurosawa asks him out on a date! But Tsuge suddenly shows up... Though they were supposed to go on their first date, the two of them are unable to abandon Tsuge while he's worried about Minato. Together they go to watch Minato practice dancing instead, where they run into Rokkaku. While hearing Minato's true feelings, watching Tsuge and Minato's relationship deepen, and spending time with Kurosawa, Adachi experiences heartwarming feelings for the first time.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Episode 9
episodes.description: It's been nine days since Adachi and Kurosawa started dating. They eat together, have agreed to reattempt to go on their first date, and in general couldn't be happier. Meanwhile, Tsuge has been confused ever since he saw Minato and Keita kiss and has been avoiding Minato. Adachi suddenly asks to meet him, but when he shows up, Rokkaku grabs him by the collar? Tsuge reaches a certain decision and goes to see Minato.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Episode 10
episodes.description: While Kurosawa continues to get closer to Adachi as his boyfriend, Adachi worries about whether or not he should keep his magic power a secret. With advice from Tsuge, Adachi secretly decides not to use his power to read people's thoughts anymore, but a certain event throws Adachi's feelings into chaos...

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Episode 11
episodes.description: Adachi is wondering if it's okay to keep the magic secret while he is steadily deepening his bond with Kurosawa as a lover.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Episode 12
episodes.description: After breaking up with Kurosawa, Adachi feels down. He has a meal with Tsuge who gives him advice about his love life. Adachi makes a decision about how to proceed with Kurosawa.

title: Blend · S
description: High school girl Maika Sakuranomiya has trouble finding a part-time job because of how scary she looks when smiling. However, she is scouted one day by Dino, the manager of the café Stile where its waitresses play unique traits such as tsundere and younger sister. Maika is given a sadist trait because of her looks and has to adopt a dominant and cruel persona when servicing customers, particularly masochist ones.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - First-Time Super Sadist
episodes.description: Sixteen-year-old Maika Sakuranomiya dreams of studying abroad, so she wants to find a part-time job to save up money for it. Unfortunately, the naturally menacing look in her eyes has torpedoed all of her job interviews so far, leaving her feeling dejected. But then, Dino, a foreigner with blond hair, suddenly appears before Maika and invites her to work at his coffee shop. She’s thrilled to score her first job, but there’s a catch...

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Sweets Without Honor
episodes.description: Ever since Maika has been assigned the "sadist character," she's been practicing to get it right with the customers. Even though it doesn't go as planned, Maika seems to have a naturally sadistic streak that is popular with the regulars. Other than that, Café Stile has a tradition in which the staff members compete every season to add a new item to the menu. Kaho, Akizuki and the manager are pitted against Maika and Mafuyu.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - After the Date, Rated R
episodes.description: The manager, Dino, continues to lose sleep due to watching too much late-night anime. Maika is interested in foreign animation herself. When Dino asks her why she's so enamored of foreign countries and wants to study abroad, Maika shares childhood memories and talks about her family. Meanwhile, Dino wants to get closer to Maika and asks her out on a date.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - The New Girl Is a Big Sister
episodes.description: Café Stile gets a new waitress, Miu Amano, and she's assigned to play a "big sister" character. Actually, Miu has a surprising secret that astonishes the rest of the Stile staff when they hear it. She masters the "big sister" act right off the bat, and in fact, Maika makes an effort to learn from her as a "role model" of how to masterfully interact with the clients, but it doesn't go so well.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Rainy and Then Windy
episodes.description: It's Pony Tail Day at Café Stile and all of the staff members fix their hair accordingly. However, when Kaho undoes Maika's braids, a shocking truth comes to light. After work, something dreadful happens to Akizuki and Kaho, both of whom have become too involved with a video game! And when Maika catches a cold, she takes time off from the job. The Stile staffers pay her a sick visit at home, but first encounter Maika's family.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - By the Waterfront Et Cetera (For Adults)
episodes.description: A refreshing breeze blows on the riverbank where the Café Stile staff is having a get-together. Maika is excited despite the party-poopiness of the "indoor kids," Kaho, Akizuki and Miu. Eventually, they start prepping for a barbecue, but a certain ingredient Maika brought takes them all aback. Dino and Maika make tentative plans to go to the beach next.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Busy with Bananas and Strawberries
episodes.description: Looking at the staffs' sunburns from the beach, Dino decides to turn Café Stile into a jungle café for a limited time. Mafuyu, in her special, unique cosplay for the event, is a huge hit among the customers. On the other hand, Kaho and Akizuki are involved in an accident with all of the new plant decorations in the café. The following day, Dino enlists Maika to go shopping with him for strawberries that he forgot to order beforehand.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - An Idol Character, Too
episodes.description: Business is booming at Café Stile, but they are now short-handed. Desperately in need of extra hands, they put up job postings to seek a part-timer and an applicant comes in for an interview right away. While Maika, Kaho, and the rest of the Stile staff members are charmed by the cute girl, who talks like a boy, Dino is hesitant for some reason...

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Owner Inauguration, Sister Attack
episodes.description: Maika brings a big stray dog she found on her way to Café Stile. Because she cannot keep the dog at her house, she needs to find a new home for the dog, but there are no takers. Eventually, Dino is pressed into taking care of the dog, with menacing eyes that resemble Maika's, at his place for the time being. Maika decides to bake sweets for Dino to show her appreciation.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - I'll Teach You ♡
episodes.description: A customer at Café Stile confesses to Mafuyu. However, she is immediately ready to reject, as not only is there a considerable height difference between the two, but her true self is too different from the character she plays at work. But even her little brothers have been worrying that she will never have a boyfriend. Meanwhile, Kaho's string of failing marks at school prompts her mother to ban all video games unless she gets an average score or higher on the makeup test. Mafuyu agrees to supervise Kaho's study sessions, but...

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Good at Tsundere, Bad at Cornering
episodes.description: On their day off, Dino goes to the park with Maika and Owner, the dog. The day is a dream come true for Dino, while Owner also falls in love with another dog. Meanwhile, at Café Stile, Kaho is devastated after accidentally erasing data for one of her favorite video games. Akizuki is trying to somehow console Kaho, following an unintentional, yet indelicate remark, but...

episodes.title: Ep 12 - I Love You!
episodes.description: The Café Stile members are on a ski trip, when Dino finally decides to confess his feelings to Maika. However, there is an unexpected turn of events when Maika, right out of the bath, suddenly interrupts him. Is Maika going to beat Dino to the punch and confess her love for him?! The following day, Maika has an unforeseen, shocking confession for Kaho, Miu and Mafuyu.

title: Dead Mount Death Play
description: As a legendary hero nears victory against a necromancer known as The Corpse God, things take an unexpected turn with the dark sorcerer’s final gambit—reincarnation magic. This last-ditch effort catches the brave fighter off guard, and now he’s a boy named Polka Shinoyama in a whole new world! The showdown between good and evil just got epic.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - The Reincarnation
episodes.description: A legendary necromancer known as the Corpse God is finally slain by a hero—only to wake up in the body of Polka Shinoyama, a newly assassinated boy in present-day Tokyo. Can the sorcerer survive in this strange new world?

episodes.title: Ep 2 - The New World
episodes.description: Polka scrambles to get his bearings while facing off against his would-be killer's colleagues. Is this the prelude to a new fight for survival or the start of an unlikely friendship?

episodes.title: Ep 3 - The Necromancer
episodes.description: Polka is settling into his new life when a man arrives begging Misaki to save him from gangsters. Polka sends her with him, but the job isn't what it seems. Meanwhile, other factions in Shinjuku investigate Polka's role in the fire.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - The Mad Dog
episodes.description: Polka's recent activities have caught the eye of a police unit dedicated to hunting down the most bizarre and seemingly superhuman offenders. To a peace-seeking necromancer, these cops could be worse trouble than the criminals he's fallen in with!

episodes.title: Ep 5 - The Monster
episodes.description: Just when he thought the cops were bad enough, Polka comes face to face with Lemmings, Shinjuku's most legendary criminal. Will Polka reveal his necromancy to save his new friends? And will his powers even be enough to save them if he does?

episodes.title: Ep 6 - The Firestarter
episodes.description: Keeping his promise to a ghost, Polka returns to his family's mansion with Misaki in tow. Can the necromancer fool the people who know the real Polka best? And can he save them from an unknown threat without arousing their suspicions?

episodes.title: Ep 7 - The Magician
episodes.description: The Shinoyama family is out of danger, but the Corpse God still needs to explain himself to Polka's father, Rozan! How will the gruff tycoon react to his youngest son's fate? Meanwhile, an eccentric criminal stages a jailbreak.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - The Assassin
episodes.description: Polka is about to resume business as usual when he gets two unexpected houseguests: his niece Sayo and her bodyguard! Do the pair just need a place to crash, or is something more sinister at play? And Inspector Iwanome is still on Polka's track.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - The Signpost
episodes.description: Inspector Iwanome pressures Polka into reading his fortune. What does the inspector hope to gain, and what will he do when the reading dredges up secrets from his past? Meanwhile, the date of the Phantom Solitaire's "performance" is fast approaching.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - The Emblem
episodes.description: Solitaire fills the skies of Shinjuku with blimps—all marked with the emblem of the Corpse God's home country! What is a symbol from another world doing in modern Japan, and who will take the magician's bait?

episodes.title: Ep 11 - The Beginning
episodes.description: While everyone scrambles to discover the secret of the emblem, Polka receives an unexpected visitor. The modern world's most dangerous individuals are starting to realize that the fortune teller is more than he appears.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - The Sacred Place
episodes.description: As a string of criminals, cops, and assassins converge on his building, the Corpse God finally decides to take action. How far will the necromancer go to defend his new home? And what new attention will his actions draw in a world without magic?

episodes.title: Ep 13 - The Invaders
episodes.description: Polka's magical rampage has drawn even more unwanted attention to his new home. As if thrill-seeking magicians and underworld hitmen weren't bad enough, he now has a shrewd reporter to contend with.

title: The Kingdoms of Ruin
description: Witches were once respected for the wisdom and magic they gifted to humans. But with the rise of the Gear Expansion era, the new science community deemed them as enemies who hindered the progress of society. Thus began the slaughter of all witches, including one who had mentored a human boy named Adonis. After witnessing her death, Adonis vows to bring bloodshed and terror to the human race.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - And So, Our Story Begins
episodes.description: The rapid explosion of human technology has caused humanity to grow to fear and resent the divinely granted supernatural powers of witches. The witch Chloe and her apprentice, Adonis, find themselves caught in the crosshairs of the Redia Empire.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Heavenly Fire
episodes.description: Adonis uses his newfound freedom to wreak havoc on the city of New Nightmare. His long-practiced written-style summoning magic tears through the Radian citizens while Doroka races to meet up with him.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - A Gentle Death
episodes.description: The various government institutions of Redia scramble to stop Adonis' rampage. When they go to activate the Magic Photon Suppression Device, Theta, the director of the National Science Agency, shares previously hidden information.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - The Nation of Witches
episodes.description: Anna is ultimately successful in her mission and manages to use her magic to fool the Redia Empire long enough to extract Adonis. Adonis is extracted by the witches and witnesses firsthand the state of their society in the wake of their war with humanity.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Joy to the World
episodes.description: As the resurrection ritual comes to completion, Lunamilia is suddenly attacked by the National Security Bureau. The safety of the witches is compromised, and the mito is set ablaze. Adonis and Yamato face off in a revenge-fueled duel.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - The Witch Doroka
episodes.description: Doroka finally calls upon her magical powers in an attempt to put an end to the carnage on Lunamilia. As the battle on the moon comes to a close, we discover who's truly in control of the Redia Empire.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Stand by him. Stand by her.
episodes.description: Adonis and Doroka find themselves on the planet's surface once again. Still reeling from the carnage on the moon, they encounter some wasteland vagrants who take them in. However, there may be more to these vagrants than expected.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Coronation
episodes.description: With Goethe and the witches out of her way, Dorothea ascends to the imperial throne. As she uses her magic to consolidate her power, Shirousagi searches the wastelands for Adonis. Meanwhile, Adonis and Doroka stumble into a seemingly abandoned ghost town.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - The Ruined Kingdom of Mamuta
episodes.description: Adonis and Doroka arrive at the city-state of Mamuta only to find it devoid of human life. Strange stirrings of something far from human echo throughout the city as two opposing parties begin to close in on Adonis and Doroka.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - The Eyes That Were Lost
episodes.description: Shirousagi has found Adonis and Doroka with the help of the National Intelligence Agency. He brings the full power of humanity's technology to bear against Adonis and Doroka in a brutal battle.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Knightfall
episodes.description: Adonis has to face Shirousagi alone while trying to protect an incapacitated Doroka. When his limits are reached, the two of them work together through unsavory means in a desperate attempt to survive.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Love and Revenge
episodes.description: Empowered by Doroka's Love Spell, Adonis reaches new heights of physical and magical power. He unleashes his magic in a way that fulfils a promise he made to Chloe long ago.

keywords: magic,based on comic,based on manga,shounen,anime,edge,science fantasy

title: A Girl & Her Guard Dog
description: Isaku just wants to live a normal life. But as the granddaughter of a yakuza boss, that’s a pretty tall order. For years, it’s been difficult for Isaku to make friends and find love. So, she decides to enroll in a high school far from her hometown in hopes of a fresh start. But her plans take an unexpected turn when a worried member of the yakuza, Keiya, enrolls in the same school to protect her.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - SPRING AND BEGINNINGS
episodes.description: Isaku gets into the high school that she wanted, and is excited to finally meet classmates who don't know she's the granddaughter of a yakuza boss. Unfortunately, her family member/crush/bodyguard decides to attend school with her.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - MAIDENLY FEELINGS AND PARENTAL FEELINGS
episodes.description: Isaku tries her best to get over Keiya, and she finally starts to make a new friend. But when she sneaks out to karaoke with her new friends, she learns that not all friends are what they appear to be.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - KISSES AND LOVE
episodes.description: Isaku is frustrated with Keiya when he doesn't even try to pass his tests at school. They agree that she'll give him a reward if he passes his next make-up exam, but the reward he asks for is nothing Isaku could have expected.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - DUTY AND DANGER
episodes.description: Isaku, Keiya, and their class go on a trip to the beach. Isaku continues to grapple with her feelings for Keiya, but there seems to be danger lurking around every corner lately.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - STRIFE AND SETTLEMENT
episodes.description: Isaku is kidnapped by members of the Kodan-gumi, and Keiya has to save her. Although Isaku's summer break comes to an end, Keiya tries to make up for lost time with an in-house summer vacation getaway.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - A MIDSUMMER AND NIGHT'S DREAM
episodes.description: Isaku is super bored after finishing her summer break homework, so Keiya suggests going to a festival together. Is it a friendly outing, or is it a date?!

episodes.title: Ep 7 - TANUKI AND GUARD DOG
episodes.description: Isaku and Keiya meet Mikio, the grandson of another yakuza gang's boss. They're not fans.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - CHEAP THEATRICS AND MELODRAMA
episodes.description: The class practices Romeo and Juliet for the culture festival, and Keiya loses his cool with Mikio. Isaku has after-rehearsal practice, and someone unexpectedly shows their true colors.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - KNIVES AND ATTACKS
episodes.description: With Keiya unable to act while Mikio has a knife at Isaku's throat, it looks like both Keiya and Isaku are at Mikio's mercy. But when Mikio attempts to sexually assault Isaku, she doesn't play the role he scripted for her.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - LINGERING SCENTS AND WHISPERS
episodes.description: As Mikio exits stage left, another wrinkle in Isaku and Keiya's relationship enters stage right.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - DAYS GONE BY AND DAYS TO COME
episodes.description: After what Keiya told her, Isaku needs to make a decision about what to do next. But who can she go to for advice?

episodes.title: Ep 12 - SCUM AND HEART
episodes.description: Isaku works up the nerve to confess her feelings to Keiya, and not only is Keiya's response upsetting, but he also almost kisses another girl at school the next day. Isaku's friends try to give him advice on how to rectify his mistakes.

episodes.title: Ep 13 - WOUNDS AND LOVERS
episodes.description: Isaku recounts her life and the past year with Keiya. Although things are awkward at first, the two are able to make up.

title: The Diary of Ochibi
description: In Mametsubu-cho, a little town somewhere in Japan's ancient capital of Kamakura, the cheerful Ochibi lives a free and easy life. Together with his friends — the dog Nazeni, the mischievous cat Jack, and the ever-hungry pooch Pankui — he welcomes the new discoveries and acquaintances that come with the changing seasons. The spring brings flowers and greenery; the summer, chances to swim in the cool sea. With autumn come the fiery red maples, and winter brings hot and hearty meals. These events and shifts of season are drawn with a soft and tender touch, bringing out the warmth in the details of everyday life.

title: Bikkurimen
description: The story is set in a world where the value of Bikkuri-Man stickers are so high that they have to be transported in a cash transport vehicle. There was also the famous robbery case one year ago, called the "300 million Bikkuri-Man sticker case." One day, a high-school delivery part-timer named Yamato gets involved in a battle over stickers between two competing convenience stores. The Angel Mart owned by the Phoenix store manager is famous for its easy-to-use glitter stickers. The Devil Store across the street also tries to attract Bikkuri-Man fans to their store. Former comrades are divided into allies and foes, and the battle of destiny begins.

title: The Yuzuki Family's Four Sons
description: The four Yuzuki brothers—Hayato, Mikoto, Minato, and young Gakuto—lost their parents two years ago and now work to raise themselves. Together they live, learn, fight, and forgive as brothers should.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - Yuzuki's House
episodes.description: The Yuzuki brothers, consisting of the eldest son, Hayato; the second son, Mikoto; the third son, Minato; and the youngest, Gakuto, have been living together since they lost their parents two years ago.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - The Outcome of Uta's Love
Ep 7 - Minato's Encounter
episodes.description: Minato first met his best friend Uta when they were elementary school students. Uta, who moved next to the Yuzuki family, responded coldly to Minato and Mikoto. Determined to become friends with Uta no matter what, Minato enthusiastically keeps inviting them to play, but...

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Gakuto's Secret
episodes.description: A class observation day was scheduled to be held in Gaku's class. However, Gaku was worried that if Hayato took a day off to attend, it would cause inconvenience at his workplace and increase his workload.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Classroom Visitation
episodes.description: Gakuto is keeping his class observation day from Hayato by using a stand-in.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Mikoto and His Little Brothers
episodes.description: The Yuzuki family's four brothers cherish each other deeply. Among them, the second son, Mikoto, dotes on Minato, the third son, while Minato, in turn, adores Gakuto, the youngest.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Hayato Catches a Cold
episodes.description: Hayato catches a cold. Mikoto, Minato, and Gakuto are eager to care for Hayato and handle the household chores. Even when they run into the Kirishima family on their way to a trip, they keep Hayato's condition a secret, not wanting to worry them before their vacation.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - The Day-to-Day Lives of the Yuzuki Brothers
episodes.description: Gakuto won a diary. Wondering what to write as the entry, Mikoto mentions, "You can also write about your thoughts and feelings." Encouraged by this, Gakuto chronicles the daily happenings in the Yuzuki household...

keywords: sibling relationship,slice of life,based on manga,family,shoujo,anime

title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby
description:
In a world very much like our own, great race horses of the past have a chance to be reborn as "horse girls"—girls with the ears and tails of horses as well as their speed and endurance. The best of these horse girls go to train at Tokyo's Tracen Academy, hopefully moving on to fame and fortune as both racers and idols.

Special Week, a high school horse girl from the countryside, has just transferred to Tracen, and she's determined to fulfill her promise to her mother to become the best horse girl in Japan. On her way to school, she takes a pit stop at the race track and instantly falls in love with Silence Suzuka's style, becoming determined to race on the same team as her.

episodes.title: Ep 1 - The Stage Long Dreamed Of
episodes.description: Kitasan Black hopes to duplicate Tokai Teio's feat of winning the Japanese Derby after coming in third at the Satsukishou. But the Japanese Derby's course layout doesn't support her strengths as a racer...

episodes.title: Ep 2 - The Start Line
episodes.description: Kitasan Black is down in the dumps over her poor showing in the Japanese Derby, especially when compared to the star horse girl Duramente. Her dream of being like her idol Tokai Teio seems farther away than ever.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - The Dream Never Ends
episodes.description: The time has come for the public to vote for the horse girls that will participate in the Arima Kinen, and Kitasan Black stands a good chance of making the cut. Everyone talks about their plans for the future while celebrating Satono Diamond's debut.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - My Own Shine
episodes.description: Kitasan Black is stuck in a losing streak. While talking to Nice Nature, she gets the idea to attempt a more intensive training regimen, since she's not prone to injury. Trainer isn't convinced that's such a good idea...

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Proving Oneself
episodes.description: Satono Diamond runs in the Japanese Derby, the race coming down to a photo finish. Meanwhile, Kitasan's times are better than ever after her intense training session. But Kitasan's hopes might be dashed by Duramente's recovery...

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Diamond
episodes.description: Everyone seems to think Satono Diamond can't win the Kikkashou because of the jinx on Satono horse girls. She decides to face the jinx head-on and prove there's nothing stopping Satono horse girls from winning Triple Crown races.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Our Arima Kinen
episodes.description: Kitasan Black is on a winning streak heading into this year's Arima Kinen. Satono Diamond, having "broken" the jinx on Satono horse girls, is determined to win the Arima Kinen next and so prove that she is stronger than Kitasan.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - What's Always Been There
episodes.description: With the Arima Kinen over, Kitasan Black tries to come to terms with the outcome. She tries talking through her feelings with other horse girls, and learns about the dreams that Satono Diamond and Duramente are pursuing.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Pushed by the Approaching Heat
episodes.description: Her focus renewed, Kitasan Black's performance in races is improving. She asks Satono Diamond to go on a trip with her. After playing rock-paper-scissors to select their destination, the two go on a long train trip together.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Festival
episodes.description: Tracen Academy and the nearby town are holding a festival together, and the school has asked Kitasan Black to head up the committee.The festival is a great success, prompting her to think about running the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Decision
episodes.description: Kitasan Black resumes training, but she's still troubled by how she felt at the end of the Takarazuka Kinen. She throws herself into practice, but Trainer has started to suspect something about her might have changed.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Kitasan Black
episodes.description: Kitasan Black holds a press conference to announce that she will retire after this year's Japan Cup and Arima Kinen, shocking both her fans and friends who didn't know about her decline in conditioning.

episodes.title: Ep 13 - And Yours...
episodes.description: Kitasan Black furiously trains for her last Arima Kinen. Team Spica together works to fulfill her final request for the race. Anticipation builds across Japan as fans realize this will be their last chance to see Kitasan Black run in the Twinkle Series.

title: BULLBUSTER
description: Mysterious creatures have been terrorizing an island, forcing locals to flee their once-thriving home. With government funds lacking for monster eradication, Tajima purchases the only construction company left and transforms it for the task. Thankfully, the brilliant Testuro Okino and his new robot, Bullbuster, come to their aid. But the team is on a tight budget. Can they save the island?

episodes.title: Ep 1 - Bullbuster, Activate! A Small Business on the Verge of Bankruptcy Challenges a Mysterious Monster?!
episodes.description: Pest control company, Namidome Industries, receives a new helper robot along with a new pilot for it at a critical time. But what exactly are these so-called "pests" they are tasked with exterminating?

episodes.title: Ep 2 - No Money! No Ship, Either?! The Only Way to Survive Is to Rebrand Namidome!
episodes.description: Namidome's history as a construction company brings them under fire from the local Builders Union, which fears the competition they might represent. To relieve the pressure, they'll need to undergo a full rebrand.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - Okino Steps in It! The Islanders Are Angry... In the Company's Hour of Need, Its President Stands Tall!
episodes.description: Tetsuro makes a terrible mistake that could threaten the very existence of Namidome Industries. More information about the islanders' plight comes to light, while Tajima pursues the mystery of the toxic gas.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - The Incredible Operation to Capture a Giant Beast Alive Begins!
episodes.description: Arumi's late-night run-in with a smaller "pest" on Ryugan Island raises a number of questions on the true nature of the Giant Beasts and reviewing footage captured by Bullbuster reveals something startling.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - We Can Count on Manpower! The Help of a Young Researcher Reveals the Truth of the Giant Beasts?!
episodes.description: While a Shiota Chemical offer to send the company a college-educated intern leaves Tetsuro feeling threatened, a brave move by a young researcher may be the break they need to learn what the Giant Beasts really are.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - The New Star Employee Is a Problem Child?! Okino Snaps at the Cold-Hearted Smarty-Pants!
episodes.description: The new intern arrives but immediately starts getting the backs up of the rest of the team. Meanwhile, the mouse released by Tetsuro on Ryugan Island re-emerges in an altered state.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Shiro Loses Control! Can They Save Their Stranded Companions? Bullbuster’s First Urban Battle!
episodes.description: The Giant Beast that was formerly Arumi's pet dog turns out to be less dead than it first appeared. With it running amok in Shiota Bio's HQ, can the team neutralize the threat before things get even more out of hand?

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Muto Roars! The Sorrows of a Man Left Behind by Time... And What Does Shiota Have Up Its Sleeve?
episodes.description: With the company modernizing more and more, old hand Muto feels like things were simpler before all the high-tech machines and smartphones. But with the bigwigs looking to throw extra funds at Namidome, will this stick-in-the-mud prove to be a hindrance?

episodes.title: Ep 9 - The Merger Draws Near! Shiota's Plot, and the Origin of the Giant Beasts, Are Both Revealed! What Will Namidome Do?
episodes.description: As the finer points of the prospective merger between Shiota and Namidome Industries get hammered out, a potential root cause of the giant beast mutation is finally discovered.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Namidome Industries on the Verge of Collapse! A Clash of Emotions... Tajima Makes the Hard Call!
episodes.description: Following the bombshell about the potential origins of the Giant Beasts, each member of the team grapples with what to do with the info. Will they simply stay quiet and let the merger happen as planned, or will their desire for the truth win out?

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Namidome Strikes Back! The Secret Weapon to Resist an Evil Corporation Is... Leather Coral?!
episodes.description: After the collapse of the merger between Namidome Industries and Shiota, it seems like Namidome's days are numbered. That is, until a man representing another company shows up with an interesting proposal...

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Rise, Bullbuster! All Out War Between Namidome and Shiota! Which Will Prevail: the Big Business’s Logic or the Small Business’s Guts?!
episodes.description: Standing up for the little guy against big business, Namidome Industries declares war on Shiota Chemical and sets about ridding Ryugan Island of the Giant Beasts as well as the bacteria that has been causing the animals to mutate.

title: OVERTAKE!
description: Haruka Asahina is a high school teen racing in Formula 4. He crosses paths with a washed-up photographer, Kōya Madoka, who decides to help Haruka realize his dream and reach the podium. The heat is on, and competition is fierce. Racing for the family-run Komaki Motors team means Haruka must push the car, and himself, to the limits to catch the attention of top teams. Buckle up, it’s time to race!

episodes.title: Ep 1 - The Man Who Races
episodes.description: Photographer Kouya Madoka is assigned to work a Super GT event, but as he wanders through the support race paddock, his curiosity is piqued by the sheer variety of teams and drivers on display in the world of Formula 4.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Enthusiasm and Spirit
episodes.description: An inspired Madoka barges into Komaki Motors HQ and declares he wants to sponsor their F4 outfit, but it quickly becomes apparent that he has no idea how much it actually costs to go racing.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - How Many Kilometers to the Winner's Podium?
episodes.description: Komaki Motors finally have a sponsor, but Haruka may not be so happy about the terms of the deal. Though out on track, money for more tires equals more practice time. Can Haruka make good use of the extra track time?

episodes.title: Ep 4 - The Past and Regrets
episodes.description: The commercial is ready to air, but Haruka isn't happy about Kouya's photograph being inserted, leading to past traumas being revisited.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Chariots of Fire
episodes.description: Haruka and the two drivers from Belsorriso, Satsuki and Toshiki, take part in a race of a different kind.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Suzuka, Rain
episodes.description: Haruka is flying high in qualifying for the next round at Suzuka, but when race day comes and the heavens open, he is faced with the tough decision of which tires to run.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Underexposure
episodes.description: Satsuki's horror crash reopens old wounds, and to make matters worse, Mikazuki Beverages abruptly end their sponsorship deal with Komaki Motors. How will Haruka—and more importantly, Kouya—cope with this sudden turn of events?

episodes.title: Ep 8 - Birds of a Feather
episodes.description: While Satsuki recovers from his injuries in hospital, his replacement hasn't exactly impressed those in charge at Belsorriso, leading their eyes to be cast in the direction of Haruka.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - The Day of the Disaster
episodes.description: Haruka tracks down Kouya, who has returned to the small town that was ravaged by a tsunami triggered by an earthquake 12 years before.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - Never Say Never
episodes.description: Now that Kouya has found some form of resolution to the trauma haunting him, everyone's attention turns to Haruka and his goal of standing on the top step of the F4 podium.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - Hop → Step →
episodes.description: After a disappointing conclusion to the last race due to his tires going off, Haruka is determined to do better next time out. Meanwhile, Harunaga is out of the hospital and straight back in the car.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - Overtake
episodes.description: The FIA Japanese F4 Championship is reaching its climax and it all comes down to this race at Fuji Speedway. Will Haruka finally get to stand on the top step of the podium?

title: Dog Signal
description: A dog trainer is a job that connects dogs and people. An indecisive young man, Miyu Samura, met Shinichiro Niwa, a miracle-working dog trainer, while walking the dog of his ex-girlfriend. The accidental encounter will greatly change Miyu's life! This is a story about the growth of a new dog trainer!

episodes.title: Ep 7 - Things I Want to Protect
Ep 15 - The Old Man and the Old Dog
Ep 18 - The Comic Artist and the Shiba Inu

keywords: workplace,slice of life,based on manga,anime,josei,boys' love (bl)

title: Firefighter Daigo: Rescuer in Orange
description: Daigo Toake burns with remarkable talent and unparalleled determination. Shun Onoda struggles against the walls blocking his own path. Yuki Nakamura hopes to become one of the few female members of the special rescue corps known as "Orange." When these three young firefighters who share the goal of becoming members of Orange come together, the story of how Japan will one day be saved begins... and what looms before them is a crisis that endangers the entire country!

episodes.title: Ep 1 - The Destined Three
episodes.description: As he watches the famed Toake Daigo pull off another rescue so daring others might think it impossible, Fire Sergeant Onoda Shun thinks back to their days in special rescue training together, and how their working relationship began.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - Firefighter
episodes.description: The "destined three" are assigned to a firefighting exercise together, where they must rescue a dummy from a training building that's really on fire. When they realize a true survivor would never survive the smoke, a difficult decision awaits them...

episodes.title: Ep 3 - The God of Rescue
episodes.description: Daigo, Shun, and Yuki struggle to complete their task in the fire fighting training tower. Yamagami's evaluation of their group is not at all what they expect, but they learn about an additional rule of the Special Rescue Corps.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Fuwa Special Rescue Corps
episodes.description: Half a year after their training, Shun is finally going to work with Daigo in the Fuwa Fire Station’s Special Rescue Squad. He’s nervous about his first day when suddenly they have to move out! On the scene, Daigo does something surprising!

episodes.title: Ep 5 - 252
episodes.description: “Please let me go.” With those words, Daigo actually dislocates his own shoulder and goes into the crevice in the rubble. What an unbelievably calm way to continue the rescue mission.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - Toake Daigo
episodes.description: After his heroic efforts in Ariwara district, Daigo is hospitalized. In fact, he had dislocated his shoulders many times in his past and was scolded for it by the nurses. While talking, Daigo remembers the time he became “Toake Daigo.”

episodes.title: Ep 7 - My Hero
episodes.description: The fire at Hotel New Snysis was called the worst fire in history. Even though Yuki lost four members of her family in that fire, she still aspired to become a firefighter, with a certain heroic “Legendary Rescue Corps Member” in her heart.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - The Three in the Basement
episodes.description: With a typhoon approaching, Shun and his squad have to move out. For some reason, Daigo ends up being locked in the basement! Will they be able to rescue the survivors as the rain water keeps flowing into the basement?

episodes.title: Ep 9 - Mission
episodes.description: The typhoon has caused severe flooding. Shun and Igarashi dive into the water with their respirators to help Daigo and the survivors from a basement that is steadily filling with rain water.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - The Auspicious "Fire Company M"
episodes.description: The door that had trapped Daigo and the two survivors is finally open. Where will the water that rushes out in an instant take them?! Meanwhile, Shun was diving underwater with his face mask on for the rescue operation...

episodes.title: Ep 11 - The True Sign of a Buddy
episodes.description: The Fuwa Rescue Corps is on the scene at a collapsed street. A car has fallen into the hole, so Daigo and Shun descend using the flexible ladder mounted on their truck. That’s when Daigo senses something...

episodes.title: Ep 12 - The Job of Those in Orange
episodes.description: At the scene of a collapsed street, Daigo and Shun discover a car with a survivor buried in the sand. However, nothing they do seems to work and they can’t make any progress. That’s when they suggest pulling out the car with the truck’s ladder, but...

episodes.title: Ep 13 - Their Respective Emotions
episodes.description: Daigo and Shun can’t shake the fact that they failed to save the pregnant woman at the collapsed road. Meanwhile, the 1st squad member of Shogadani Rescue, Matoi Sadaie, and Nagata Sakura meet in an unlikely location.

episodes.title: Ep 14 - The National Firefighter Rescue Technique Tournament
episodes.description: Fuwa Fire Station has begun training for the National Fire Fighter Rescue Technique Tournament. Meanwhile, Yuki’s first mission in Fire Company M is to take first place in the tournament’s individual rope bridge traversal discipline.

episodes.title: Ep 15 - Special Order Dispatch
episodes.description: Fuwa Rescue and Shougadani Rescue have come to train for the Tokyo Fire Department’s internal selection tournament. While all of them are focused on their training, a fire breaks out in a high rise building. Both squads receive a special order dispatch.

episodes.title: Ep 16 - Morse Code
episodes.description: Fuwa Rescue and Shougadani Rescue are on the scene of the fire at the high-rise building. There should be many people in need of rescue at the internet café where the fire broke out, but for some reason, almost nobody is there...

episodes.title: Ep 17 - Asahina Daigo
episodes.description: With the additional help of Yuki and Toyomu, Daigo and Shun manage to rescue every single person. A few days later, the two of them get summoned to the district headquarters for a debriefing, where they get subjected to a behavioral audit, but then...

title: The Family Circumstances of the Irregular Witch
description: When witch Alyssa found a baby on her doorstep, she didn’t expect her life to take a topsy-turvy turn. Despite her bewilderment, she names the child Viola and decides to raise her. Fast-forward 16 years, and her “daughter” Viola isn’t just taller—she’s towering! Join this bewitching duo in a hilariously chaotic journey of mistaken identities and supernatural shenanigans!

episodes.title: Ep 1 - The Irregular Circumstances of the Close-Knit Family / The Educational Circumstances of the Mysterious Life Form
episodes.description: Viola desperately wants to summon a phoenix, and then she desperately wants a familiar. But is she really ready for the responsibility?

episodes.title: Ep 2 - The Commonplace Circumstances of the Witch's Child-Rearing / The Romantic Circumstances of the Little Brother Position
episodes.description: Lira recalls Alyssa's early days with baby Viola. An elfin merchant comes to visit Alyssa.

episodes.title: Ep 3 - The Reminiscing Circumstances of the Witch-Girl Time Crew / The Sniffly Circumstances of the Healthy Daughter
episodes.description: The whole gang reminisces as they look through a magical photo album together. Then Viola catches a cold, which she handles in a totally mature and reasonable way.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - The Requesting Circumstances of the Late-Blooming Orc / The Monitoring Circumstances of the Egg and Big Sister
episodes.description: At the risk of his own life, Fennel sets up a blind date between Viola and a friend of his. Then, Viola and Alyssa spend a day babysitting a lizardkin egg.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - The Classified Circumstances of the Elfin Forest / The Potato-Digging Circumstances of Love and Legend
episodes.description: Fennel seizes a chance to see Alyssa when Viola is out. Then, Alyssa and Viola go to Pondo's farm to dig potatoes, but something isn't right...

episodes.title: Ep 6 - The Assemblage Circumstances of the Rose Garden
episodes.description: A garden fairy asks Alyssa for help reasoning with his brother, who has spiraled a little out of control. It's a serious situation, but Viola can't help noticing that the garden fairies look less like flowers and more like... something else.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - The Circumstances of Yep—Oops—Of Course These Are Pastries! / The Insomnia Circumstances of the Sleep Fairy
episodes.description: Viola gets the urge to bake cookies, and she decides to make them into fun shapes. Then, Alyssa and Viola try to help the Sandmann with a problem.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - The Cooking Circumstances of the Cursed Witch / The Crazed Circumstances of the Phoenix's Exam
episodes.description: When Luna comes to visit, Alyssa and Viola help her learn to cook. After eating some of Luna's "cooking", Phoenix visits the doctor. The cast reimagines classic fairytales as only they could.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - The Personal Circumstances of the Nervous Mama / The Family Circumstances of the Questionable Visitor
episodes.description: Luna is curious about the mysterious visitor Luna predicted, and tries to find out who it is. When the visitor arrives, Viola learns some very important things about Alyssa!

episodes.title: Ep 10 - The Troubled Circumstances of the Confined Son / The Public Park Circumstances of Heart vs. Tongue
episodes.description: Lira and Pound's son won't leave his room, and he won't explain why no matter how many times Viola asks him. Then, it's off to the park for Guita's new baby's big debut! But things get weird when an old acquaintance of Lira's appears on the scene.

episodes.title: Ep 11 - The Home Alone Circumstances of the Familiars / The Weight Loss Circumstances of the Corpulent Phoenix / The Romantic Advice Circumstances of the Men without Dates
episodes.description: Phoenix is left to mind the house alone with Koala; what can go wrong? Then, Phoenix eats a few too many of Alyssa's desserts. Meanwhile, Fennel and Glind get dating tips from an expert.

episodes.title: Ep 12 - The Family Circumstances of the Irregular Witch
episodes.description: Friends and family gather at Alyssa's house to look at photos, reminisce about old times, mock each other, engage in some light torture, and generally make the best of their circumstances.

keywords: witch,magic,slice of life,based on manga,family,fantasy world,anime,mother and daughter,fantasy,gag comedy

title: Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions
description: Ron Kamonohashi was once regarded as a genius at the top detective training academy. But after a fatal mistake, he was expelled and forbidden to become a detective. Years later, police officer Totomaru Isshiki knocks on Ron’s door seeking help on a serial murder case. He finds Ron, now a messy-haired recluse, who agrees. Together, this mismatched detective team begins solving their first mystery!

episodes.title: Ep 1 - The Case of the Metropolitan Serial Drownings
episodes.description: The Metropolitan Police Department is struggling to investigate a series of murders, yet Detective Isshiki is ordered to go home. Kiku of the General Affairs Division sends him to meet a certain sleuth—a shaggy-haired eccentric named Kamonohashi Ron.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - The Case of the Locked-Room Piggy Bank Theft
episodes.description: Ron is excited to solve cases by using Toto, but he's not on any good ones because his boss thinks he's useless. All he gets are odd jobs and busywork. Ron, however, is quite interested in a new report about coins going missing from a piggy bank...

episodes.title: Ep 3 - The Case of the Benizome Hot Spring Murder (1)
episodes.description: Ron wins a pair of tickets to a hot spring in a raffle. Toto accompanies him to stay at the Benizome Inn. The innkeeper who greets them is friendly, but he isn't who he seems. Plus, it isn't long before Ron's eccentricities begin to surface.

episodes.title: Ep 4 - The Case of the Benizome Hot Spring Murder (2)
episodes.description: There has been a murder. Ron listens to the other guests' testimonies and begins his deductions. Spitz secretly rejoices at this chance to catch Ron in the act of sleuthing, but outwardly both he and Amamiya entrust the investigation to Toto.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - The Case of the Hand Collector
episodes.description: Kawasemi Omito, a supremely skilled detective, leads a joint investigation into a serial killing case. Amamiya lends him Toto, whom Kawasemi deems so useless he's invisible. Ron appears at the newest crime scene as a consultant, irritating Kawasemi.

episodes.title: Ep 6 - The Case of the Live Broadcast Murder
episodes.description: Ron loves a certain TV show that puts psychic abilities to the test. During a live broadcast, a psychic claims he can control minds with written words. His neurosurgeon opponent refutes his claims. Then, the psychic writes the word "Death" on a card.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - The Case of the Observatory Murder (1)
episodes.description: Toto and Ron are invited to a meteor shower viewing being held on Nandan Island. Also invited is John Grizzly, an instructor at BLUE. There was a murder at the observatory years ago, so the director has brought in first-rate detectives...just in case.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - The Case of the Observatory Murder (2)
episodes.description: Ron is named main suspect in a murder and Toto investigates to clear his name. Everyone but Ron has an alibi for the time of the murder, which only seems to cement his guilt, but Toto discovers a few things that cast a new light on the incident.

episodes.title: Ep 9 - The Case of the Observatory Murder (3)
episodes.description: Toto gathers everyone together and explains the truth behind the murders. With their name exposed, the culprit takes drastic measures not to be caught, but not before revealing that there's more to this incident than anyone imagined.

episodes.title: Ep 10 - The Case of the Poisoned Latte
episodes.description: Toto is shadowed by a reporter who's a huge fan of his for the way he's solved one difficult case after another. They step into a cafe where Ron happens to be working, making things a little awkward. Then, a customer collapses to the ground—poisoned!

episodes.title: Ep 11 - The Case of the Mad Chameleon Murder
episodes.description: Toto meets Kawasemi while on a business trip to Aichi. Kawasemi's been in a slump since losing Yamane, and his powers of perception have suffered. He's investigating the Mad Chameleon, who commits a crime right in front of them!

episodes.title: Ep 12 - The Case of the Yadagami-sama Murders (1)
episodes.description: Ron agrees to take on Spitz's search request in exchange for his obtaining a file on the Bloody Training Incident. Spitz accepts Ron's terms and takes Ron and Toto to Yadamura, a village in Yamanashi prefecture where his ethnologist brother disappeared.

episodes.title: Ep 13 - The Case of the Yadagami-sama Murders (2)
episodes.description: Toto reveals the truth of the case and the culprit admits to their crimes. Ron's disorder triggers, putting the culprit in danger, but help comes from an unexpected source. Who is their last minute savior, and how are they connected to everything?

episodes.title: Ep 14 - The Case of the Shibuya Apocalypse Serial Murders (1)
episodes.description: There's been a murder in Shibuya. A man has been found killed in a ghastly and impossible manner. Toto and Amamiya arrive at the scene to find Ron already there. A mysterious message makes them wonder if there's more to the crime than meets the eye.

episodes.title: Ep 15 - The Case of the Shibuya Apocalypse Serial Murders (2)
episodes.description: There's been another murder in Shibuya. Shocked by the death, the victim's teammate runs. Ron and Toto race to catch him and find more information on the culprit picking off the hacker team. But the more they find, the more complicated things become.

episodes.title: Ep 16 - The Case of the Shibuya Apocalypse Serial Murders (3)
episodes.description: A huge monitor across the street explodes. While Ron and Toto try to make sense of events, Winter tells them that they've lost more than they realize. As Winter torments Ron with the guilt of his failure, Ron realizes that Winter is hiding something.

episodes.title: Ep 17 - The Case of the Midsummer Beachside Stand Drowning (1)
episodes.description: Toto suggests that Ron take a rest. They invite Ron's doctor, Usaki Mofu, along and head for a dip in the ocean. Ron looks forward to having shaved ice with black sugar syrup from a beachside stand, but things soon take a tragic turn.

episodes.title: Ep 18 - The Case of the Midsummer Beachside Stand Drowning (2)
episodes.description: Ron and the others interview witnesses, but everyone has an alibi for the surfer's estimated time of death. They can't find any concrete evidence that indicates who committed the murder. Then Mofu's usual clumsiness leads to an unexpected clue.

episodes.title: Ep 19 - The Case of the Genius Composer Abduction (1)
episodes.description: Ron accompanies Toto to the concert of a super popular artist Nyonyon. After the performance, a card is found in her room. It's from the Talent Abductor, Hummingbird, who has been taking geniuses of all types one after another.

episodes.title: Ep 20 - The Case of the Genius Composer Abduction (2)
episodes.description: Nyonyon has disappeared. No matter how much they search the house, there's no sign of her. Sannou presents his personal deductions and concludes that Hummingbird is actually there among them, but Ron spots a hole in his reasoning.

episodes.title: Ep 21 - The Case of the Psychology Research Lab Murder (1)
episodes.description: A lack of cases has left Ron bored, so he and Toto go with Chikori to gather information for a story she's working on. They visit a university lab researching cognitive psychology where the air is filled with hostility.

episodes.title: Ep 22 - The Case of the Psychology Research Lab Murder (2)
episodes.description: Ron and Toto present their deductions to Professor Aoe and the students who use the lab. A number of inconsistencies, starting with the postmark on the threatening letter, lead to the killer's identity and the selfish reasons for their crime.

episodes.title: Ep 23 - The Case of the Highland Auberge Serial Murders (1)
episodes.description: Ron and a number of other guests have been invited to Reunion, an auberge located on a verdant plateau. When their multi-course dinner is served, Ron notices that most everyone seems uneasy. The next morning, there's a disturbing discovery.

episodes.title: Ep 24 - The Case of the Highland Auberge Serial Murders (2)
episodes.description: A second victim is found. Ron notices a pattern in the murder scenes and decides that the key to the mystery must lie there. It soon becomes clear that the guests who were upset by the food the night before are all connected to a case from the past.

episodes.title: Ep 25 - The Case of the Highland Auberge Serial Murders (3)
episodes.description: Ron is in a state of shock after a staggering revelation. He shows no reaction when a third murder occurs. Toto investigates, dragging Ron with him. When Ron recovers enough to help with the case, he tells Toto what he's decided to do.

episodes.title: Ep 26 - The Case of the Highland Auberge Serial Murders (4)
episodes.description: The culprit behind the killings at the auberge has been identified, but Ron is still reeling from the flood of memories that this case has triggered. Will the missing pieces of his past bring him despair, or something else?

keywords: detective,based on comic,bromance,based on manga,blunt,shounen,anime,gay subtext

title: MF GHOST
description: Japan adopts self-driving electric automobiles and renders most gas engines obsolete by 202X. The fastest cars find new life in the MFG, a racing circuit held on Japanese motorways. Drivers from around the world race for a shot at the title. Kanata Rivington returns from Britain to Japan for the MFG—and to find his father. Can he win the title and find answers? Buckle up and push it to the limit!

episodes.title: Ep 1 - The Challenger from England
episodes.description: Kanata Rivington arrives in Japan from England with the intention of racing in a relatively new motorsports category that's taken the world by storm: MFG.

episodes.title: Ep 2 - The Shocking New MFG Generation
episodes.description: Kanata begins his qualifying run around the 40 kilometer-long Odawara Pikes Peak, aiming to set a quick time. But with a seriously underpowered car compared to his rivals, how high up the leaderboard can he get?

episodes.title: Ep 3 - The Kamaboko Straight
episodes.description: Impressing everyone with his drifting abilities, Kanata aims to finish his qualifying lap with a flourish. But with a long straight just before the line exposing his car's deficiencies, will he make it into the race proper?

episodes.title: Ep 4 - Tire Management
episodes.description: Ren and Kanata continue their tour of Kamakura in the hopes of finding the place where Kanata's parents took their photograph together.

episodes.title: Ep 5 - Teamwork
episodes.description: The two-lap race of Odawara Pikes Peak is underway. With his tires now up to temperature, can Kanata start making his way through the field despite his power disadvantage?

episodes.title: Ep 6 - The Tragic Rallyist
episodes.description: Kanata zooms up to the back of the Yashi-Kita Gang in no time, but getting past them is another matter entirely. Meanwhile, the two leaders go wheel-to-wheel for the lead of the race.

episodes.title: Ep 7 - The Man in the 4 Car
episodes.description: While everyone is suitably impressed with what Kanata is achieving, there are battles up and down the field, and it quickly becomes apparent that the 86 isn't the only car the MFG viewers should be keeping a close eye on.

episodes.title: Ep 8 - The Voice Callout
episodes.description: On the approach to the death zone for the second time, Kanata starts to make his move. But does he have enough life left in his tires to climb up the order?

episodes.title: Ep 9 - The 300 kph Dogfight
